1. transl. πάθος (lit.,thatwhichhappenstoapersonorthing)anditsderivatives
1.1πάθος(affect,emotion,passion)
(a)abs.:τούτωνθερμότητεςμὲνκαὶψυχρό-
τητες καὶτὰτοιαῦτα, πάθη τῆς οὐσίας (πάθη τῆς οὐσίας Arab. : πάθη, οὐκ οὐσίαι ed.)
Arist. Metaph. Β 5, 1002a2* = wa-ammā l-ḥarārātu wa-l-burūdātu llatī fī hāḏihi
l-ašyāʾi wa-mā ašbaha ḏālika fa-hiya ālāmu l-ǧawhari 276.11; ἐπεὶοὖν τοῦἑνὸς ᾗ
ἓν καὶτοῦὄντος ᾗὂν ταῦτα καὶτὰτοιαῦτα (καὶτὰτοιαῦτα Arab. : om. ed.) καθ᾽
αὑτάἐστι πάθη Γ 2, 1004b6* = fa-iḏkānat hāḏihi l-ašyāʾu wa-mā ašbahahā bi-
ḏātihā ālāma l-wāḥidi waḥdahū wa-ālāma l-huwiyyati bi-kunhihā 324.9; Γ 2,
1004b11 = 325.1; etc.
▬
καὶτὰτοιαῦτα πάθη τῆς ψυχῆς Arist. Rhet. I 1, 1354a17 =
wa-mā ašbaha ḏālika mina l-ālāmi l-muʿtariyati li-l-nafsi 2.1; καὶτρίτον τοῦπερὶ
τὰπάθη (sc. θεωρῆσαι δυναμένου), τίτε ἕκαστόν ἐστι τῶν παθῶν I 2, 1356a23 = wa-l-
ṯāliṯatu maʿrifatu l-ālāmi wa-ḏālika an yaʿrifa kulla wāḥidin mina l-ālāmi mā
huwa 9.5; I 9, 1366b29 = 44.5; etc.
▬ποῖα (ποῖα V Arab. : τὰποιάL ed.) τῶν
παθῶν προσανατρέχειν πέφυκε … τῇψυχῇArtem. Onirocr. 3.16* = ayyu l-ālāmi
yumkinu an tatarāʾā (perhaps read tataraqqā?) ilā l-nafsi 7.13*; πάθη … κοσμικὰ
καλεῖσθαι 7.13 = tusammā ālāman ʿālamiyyatan 15.8; ὅτι δ᾽ἂν περὶτὸν τράχη-
λον ἢτὴν ὑπήνην† (EDD. : κεφαλὴν Arab. : perhaps τὸν αὐχένα? cf. Pack crit. app.,
Festugière p. 48 n. 51) ἕλκος ἢπάθος ὄναρ ἔχειν νομίσῃτις 43.8*= al-ʿunuqu wa-l-
raʾsu iḏā raʾā l-insānu ka-anna fīhimā qarḥatan aw alaman 81.6
▬
γνῶσις τῆς
διαφορᾶς τῶν ἐν τοῖς μικροῖς | παιδίοις φαινομένων ἔργων τε καὶπαθῶν τῆς ψυχῆς
Galen An. virt. 32.16 = maʿrifatu ḫtilāfi afʿāli l-nafsi wa-ālāmihā l-ẓāhirati fī l-
ṣibyāni l-ṣiġāri 9.16; προωδοποίηται τοίνυν τῷπάθει 53.3 (= Arist. Part. anim. II 4,
650b28) = muʿaddun muhayyaʾun li-hāḏā l-alami 25.8; τὴν περὶτῶν παθῶν πραγ-
ματείαν 78.3 = fī kitābihī ʿalā l-ālāmi 42.10; 33.13 = 10.8, v. above alima 1.1a
▬
πρὸς τὴν ἑκάστου λοιπὸν τῶν παθῶν διαφορὰν … ἐντέχνως τοῖς φαρμάκοις χρώμε-
νοι Galen Ther. Pis. 230.4 = baʿda an tafaqqadū l-ālāma wa-alqaw li-kulli alamin
dawāʾan muwāfiqan 110a16; 218.9 = 106b6, v. above alima 1.1a
(b) in context, ala-
mun ḫulqiyyun : οὐδοκεῖλόγῳὑπείκειν τὸπάθος ἀλλὰβίᾳArist. Eth. Nic. X 9,
1179b29 = lā yuẓannu anna hāḏihi l-ālāma l-ḫulqiyyata tanqādu li-l-kalāmi bal
li-l-qahri 357.20 Badawī / 77.5 Axelroth (c) in hend. infiʿālun wa-alamun : τὰ
μὲν πάθη ἐν τοῖς πεπονθόσι τόποις Ps.-Plut. Placita 414a25 = anna l-infiʿālāti wa-
l-ālāma takūnu fī l-mawāḍiʿi llatī nālathā l-taʾṯīrātu 62.13
(d) in hend. alamun
aw āfatun : ἐπεὶδ᾽ἐγγὺς φαινόμενα τὰπάθη ἐλεεινάἐστι Arist. Rhet. II 8, 1386 a29 =
wa-ḏālika annahū iḏā kānati l-ālāmu awi l-āfātu qarībatan fa-hiya min asbābi
l-hammi 111.14.
1.2 πάθημα (condition of having been acted upon, affection) : διαφέρουσιν … εἰς
ὅσον καὶταῖς ἐνεργείαις τε καὶτοῖς παθήμασιν αὐτῶν Galen An. virt. 33.16 = bi-qadri
ḫtilāfi afʿālihā wa-ālāmihā 10.10; τὰτῶν προσπιπτόντων παθήματα 42.22 (= Plato
Tim. 43B6–C1) = al-ālāmu l-ḥādiṯatu mina l-ašyāʾi l-muṣādifati fī kulli yawmin
17.16; διὰδὴταῦτα πάντα τὰπαθήματα νῦν (παθήματα νῦν Plato, Arab. : πάθη codd.,
ed.) κατ᾽ἀρχὰς ἄνους ἡψυχὴγίγνεται τὸπρῶτον 43.1* (= PlatoTim. 44A8–B1) = fa-
minaǧli hāḏihil-ālāmikullihāṣāratil-nafsul-ānafīl-ibtidāʾitakūnu…ʿadīmata
l-ʿaqli 17.17.
1.3 παθητικός (receptive of emotion) : καὶοὐκ ἔχει (sc. τὸδημηγορεῖν) πολ-
λὰς διατριβάς, οἷον πρὸς ἀντίδικον ἢπερὶαὑτοῦἢπαθητικὸν ποιεῖν (sc. τὸν δικα-
στήν as underst. Arab.) Arist. Rhet. III 17, 1418a28 = wa-laysat fīhi (sc. fī l-tafsīri)
muḥāwaratun kaṯīratun ka-llaḏī yakūnu naḥwa l-ḫaṣmi aw min aǧli nafsihī aw
fī taṣyīri l-ḥākimi ilā l-alami 218.2.
1.4πάσχω(tohavepain[inapartof thebody];tobebesetbysuffering) (a)fīhi
alamun (aw ʿillatun) : ὅτι ἂν τούτων (sc. τῶν σιαγόνων καὶχειλέων) πάθῃArtem.
Onirocr. 36.13 = wa-li-ḏālika matā raʾā l-insānu ka-anna fīhimā (sc. al-šidqayni
wa-l-šafatayni) šayʾan mina l-alami 68.12; ἢν δέτι πάθῃ(sc. τὰγόνατα) 53.5 = |fa-
in raʾā fīhimā (sc. al-rukbatayni) alaman aw ʿillatan 100.7
▬οὐδὲν αὐτῆς τῆς
ὀπτικῆς δυνάμεωςπεπονθυίας GalenAn.virt.49.9 = min ġayrian yakūnafī l-rūḥi l-
mubṣiri šayʾun mina l-alami 22.14
(b) aṣābahū alamun : ἐξηγούμενος τὰς αἰτίας
ὧν μὲν ὑπ᾽οἴνου καὶφαρμάκων (τινῶν add. ed. : om. Arab.) πάσχομεν Galen An.
virt. 79.11* = wa-yufassiru asbāba mā yuṣībunā mina l-ālāmi [wa-] (secl. EDD.)
mina l-šarābi wa-mina l-adwiyati 43.10*.
1.5 τὸεὖπάσχειν (to be favorably acted upon)
(a) ḥusnu l-alami : καὶτὸεὖ
ποιεῖν καὶτὸεὖπάσχειν τῶν ἡδέων Arist. Rhet. I 11, 1371a35 = fa-inna ḥusna l-fiʿli
wa-ḥusna l-alami ayḍan mina l-laḏīḏāti 59.12f.; ὁμοίως καὶεὖπαθόντας ὥσπερ καὶ
κακῶς II 23, 1398a26 = wa-ka-ḏālika l-nasabu ḥusnu (sic ed. for nasabu ḥusni) l-
alami ilā sūʾi l-alami 151.9ⓧ
(b) in hend. ḥusnu l-alami awi l-infiʿāli : διὸκαὶ
τὸεὖπάσχειν τοῦεὖποιεῖν δόξειεν ἂν αἱρετώτερον εἶναι Arist. Rhet. I 7, 1365b2 =
wa-li-ḏālika mā yuẓannu ḥusnu l-alami awi l-infiʿāli āṯaru min ḥusni l-fiʿli 39.14.
1.6 sem.; etym.; ἀπάθεια (lack of affect, indifference) = in hend. qillatu alamin
wa-ktirāṯin : ἡδ᾽ἀναισχυντία ὀλιγωρία τις καὶἀπάθεια περὶτὰαὐτὰταῦτα Arist.
Rhet. II 6, 1383b16 = wa-ammā l-waqāḥatu fa-ṣiġaru l-nafsi aw tahāwunun wa-
qillatu alamin wa-ktirāṯin li-hāḏihī bi-aʿyānihā 102.3.
1.7 sem.; etym.; ἀπαθής ( free from suffering) (a) barīʾun mina l-alami : μὴ
ἄνοσος γὰρ ὢν … οὐκ ἔσται ἀπαθής Arist. Rhet. I 5, 1361b30 = fa-in kāna … laysa bi-
ġayri mimrāḍin … fa-laysa ḥīnaʾiḏin barīʾan mina l-alami 27.6f. (b) in hend. lā
yaḥtamilu alaman wa-lā taġayyuran : εἰὁνοῦς ἁπλοῦς ἐστι καὶἀπαθής Arist. De
an. III 4, 429b23 = in kāna l-ʿaqlu šayʾan mabsūṭan lā yaḥtamilu alaman wa-lā
taġayyuran 74.4.
1.8 functioning as mafʿūl muṭlaq to alima transl. πάσχω τι (be affected by s.th.
or other) : ἢπάσχειν τι ἂν εἴη (sc. τὸνοεῖν) ὑπὸτοῦνοητοῦArist. De an. III 4,
429a14 = fa-yaʾlamu (sc. al-fahmu) bi-l-maʿqūli bi-ḍarbin min ḍurūbi l-ālāmi
72.13; v. above alima 1.1, first citation.
2. transl. ἀλγέω (to feel pain) and its derivatives and compounds
2.1ἀλγέω(tohavepain[inthebody])=kānafībadanihīalamun:εἰδέτιςνοσῶν
ἢἀλγῶν τι δόξει τεθνηκέναι (δόξει τεθνηκέναι L Arab. : δόξειε τεθνάναιVed.) ἄνοσος
ἔσται καὶἄπονος (sic Arab. : ἄπονος ἔσται καὶἄνοσος ed.) Artem. Onirocr. 182.7* =
fa-ammā in kāna l-insānu marīḍan aw fī badanihī alamun fa-raʾā ka-annahū
qad māta fa-inna l-ruʾyā tadullu ʿalā burūʾihī wa-ḏahābi alamihī 329.14–15. |
2.2 ἀλγηδών (pain) : ὡς μηκέτ᾽ἔχειν … τὸπαιδίον τὰς ἀλγηδόνας GalenTher.Pis.
219.16 = wa-sakanati l-ālāmu ʿani l-fatā 107a5.
2.3 ἄλγημα (suffering) : ὥστε πολλαὶμὲν ἰδέαι τῶν ἀλγημάτων (ἀλγημάτων Gal.
[L], Arab. : νοσημάτων codd. ed.) Hippocr. Nat. hom. 168.9*= fa-yaǧibu min ḏālika
an takūna aṣnāfu l-alami kaṯīratan 3.11.
2.4 sem.; etym.; ὠταλγία (ear-ache) = alamu l-uḏuni : v. above uḏunun 1.2b,

3. transl. derivatives of πόνος (pain)
3.1sem.;etym.;ἐπιπονώτερος(morepainful)=tazayyadal-alamu:ἐπεὶδὲτοῦτο
ἰητρεύθη, ἐπιπονώτερος Hippocr.Humor.20.29 =fa-lammāʿūliǧamin ḏālikaḥattā
yabraʾa tazayyada bihī alamuhū 37.11.
3.2 sem.; etym.; ἄπονος (having no pain) = ḏahābu l-alami : v. above alamun
2.1.
4. sem.; etym.; transl. ὀδύνη (pain) in ἀνώδυνος/-ως ( free from pain) : ἰᾶται
αὐτὸκαὶεὐθέως ἀνώδυνον ἐργάζεται Galen Ther. Pis. 227.4 = yusakkinu l-alama
min sāʿatihī 109a16; καὶτῆς μυγαλῆς τὰδήγματα … αὐτῆς … ἐπιτιθεμένης ἀνωδύ-
νως θεραπεύεται· ὁμοίως δὲαὐτοὶοἱἐχιόδηκτοι ἀπαλλάττονται τοῦκινδύνου 246.17 =
wa-l-dābbatu llatī tusammā mūġālī … iḏā … wuḍiʿat ʿalā mawḍiʿi l-nahšati (sc.
nahšati l-afʿā) sakkanati l-alama 115b10.
5. πήρωσις (disability) : τῶν περὶθάνατον καὶτὰς σωματικὰς πηρώσεις (sc.
φόβων) Ps.-Arist. Virt. 1251a12 = an yaǧzaʿa l-insānu … mina l-mawti wa-l-ālāmi
l-ṭāriqati bi-ǧismihī version T 61.2.
6. σπάσμα (sprain, rupture) : τετάνοιο καὶἀρχομένοιο τενόντων σπάσματος Ga-
len Ther. Pis., Androm. 46 = (al-dawāʾu nāfiʿun) mina l-kuzāzi wa-min alami

1.1 θεός (god, deity) : φαίνοιτ᾽ἂν τὰπερὶτὰς πράξεις μικρὰκαὶἀνάξια θεῶν Arist.
Eth.Nic.X8,1178b18 = fa-sa-yaẓharu | annahā (sc. al-afʿāla) ṣaġīratun lā tastaʾhilu
an tuqāla (sic Badawī : yastaʾhilu an yuqāla Axelroth) ʿalā l-ālihati 354.4 Badawī
/ 71.2 Axelroth*; ἡτοῦθεοῦἐνέργεια 1178b21 = fiʿlu l-ilāhi 354.8 Badawī / 71.6 Axel-
roth; εἰγάρ τις ἐπιμέλεια τῶν ἀνθρώπων (ἀνθρώπων Kb Arab. : ἀνθρωπίνων codd.
cett., ed.) ὑπὸθεῶν γίνεται 1179a25*= fa-innahū in kāna yakūnu taʿāhudun (read
thus) li-l-nāsi mina l-ālihati 356.6ⓧBadawī / 74.4–5ⓧAxelroth; etc.
▬
ἀλλὰ
ἄνθρωπον ἢθεόν Arist. Metaph. Ζ 1, 1028a18 = bal innahū insānun aw ilāhun 747.3;
εἰοὖν οὕτως ἔχει (ἔχει J Arab. : εὖἔχει codd. cett., ed.), ὡς ἡμεῖς ποτέ, ὁθεὸς ἀεί,
θαυμαστόν Λ 7, 1072b25*= fa-in kāna l-ilāhu abadan ka-ḥālinā fī waqtin mā fa-
ḏālika ʿaǧībun 1614.6; τοῦτο γὰρ ὁθεός 1072b30 = wa-hāḏā huwa l-ilāhu 1615.2;
etc.
▬οὐδὲν δὲδιαφέρει περὶ… ἀνθρώπου ἢθεοῦταὐτὸτοῦτο δρᾶν Arist. Rhet.
II22,1396a24 = innahū lā farqa bayna an yufʿala ḏālika … bi-insānin aw bi-ilāhin
144.12; εἰμηδ᾽οἱθεοὶπάνταἴσασι II23,1397b12 =in lam takunil-ālihatu taʿrifukulla
šayʾin 148.21
▬
ἄλλοι δὲἄλλους τιμῶσι θεούς Artem. Onirocr. 17.7 = wa-in kāna l-
nāsu yaḫtalifūna fa-yaʿbudūna baʿḍuhum ilāhan ġayra llaḏī yaʿbuduhū ġayruhū
33.13
▬ἀγένητόν τε τὸν (τὸν LW Arab. : καὶcodd. cett., ed.) πρῶτον καὶμέγιστον
θεὸν ὁΠλάτων λέγων Galen An. virt. 74.5* = wa-l-ilāhu l-awwalu l-ʿaẓīmu yaqūlu
Aflāṭun innahū ġayru maṣnūʿin wa-lā mukawwanin 39.12
▬διὰθρησκείαν τὴν
ὑπὲρ Ῥωμαίων θεῶν ἀναγκαίως ἀγομένην τότε Galen Ther. Pis. 212.13 = bi-sababi l-
qurbāni llaḏī yuqarribuhū ahlu Rūmiyata li-l-ālihati 104b4
▬
εἰοὖν καὶὁθεὸς
αὐτοῖς κατὰτὸν νοῦν ὕστερος και γεννητὸς καὶἐπακτὸν τὸνοεῖν ἔχων, ἐνδέχοιτο ἂν
μηδὲψυχὴν μηδὲνοῦν μηδὲθεὸν εἶναι Plot. IV7, 83.11.13 ≅wa-in laǧǧū wa-qālū inna
l-ʿaqla baʿda l-nafsi wa-l-nafsu baʿda l-ṭabīʿati, lazima min qawlihim an yakūna
l-ilāhu baʿda l-ʿaqli wāqiʿan taḥta l-kawni wa-l-fasādi … wa-ḏālika muḥālun li-
annahūinamkanaanyakūnahāḏāl-tartībuḥaqqanamkanaanyakūnalānafsa
wa-lā ʿaqla wa-lā ilāha wa-hāḏā muḥālun qabīḥun ǧiddan Theol. Arist. III 39: 50.
6.8
▬
τοῦδὲθεοῦτὸπρονοεῖν καὶἀγαθῶν πάντα πληροῦν Proclus El. theol. 134:
118.22 = wa-l-mudabbiru huwa l-ilāhu li-annahū yamlaʾu l-ašyāʾa mina l-ḫayrāti
De causis 22: 100.7
▬Δημόκριτος νοῦν τὸν θεὸν Ps.-Plut. Placita 302a3 = wa-
ammā Ḏīmūqrīṭūs fa-kāna yarā anna l-ilāha huwa l-ʿaqlu 14.18; Ἀριστοτέλης τὸν
μὲν ἀνωτάτω θεὸν εἶδος χωριστόν 305a3 = wa-ammā Arisṭūṭālīs fa-innahū yarā
anna l-ilāha l-aʿlā mufāriqu l-ṣūrati (al-ṣūrati EDD. : li-l-ṣuwari ed.) 15.1*; γεγο-
νὼς … ὑπὸτοῦ| θεοῦ309a8 = mā kawwanahu l-ilāhu 16.20; etc.

λόγους Arist.Cael.II1,284b3=qālūhubi-qawlinḫurāfiyyinkamāqālūfīkaṯratil-
ālihati versionB227.4Badawī;yušabbahu(sc.qawluhum)bi-kahnihimfīkaṯrati
l-ālihati version A 76a14.
1.2 sem.; etym.; θεοφιλέστατος (most dear to god) = muḥabbun li-l-ilāhi ǧid-
dan : πάντα ταῦτα τῷσοφῷμάλισθ᾽ὑπάρχει … θεοφιλέστατος ἄρα Arist. Eth. Nic.
X8,1179a30=annaǧamīʿahāḏāli-l-ḥakīmiakṯaraḏālika…fa-iḏanhuwamuḥab-
bun li-l-ilāhi ǧiddan 356.11 Badawī / 74.11 Axelroth.
1.3 interpr.; πάϊς θεοῖο (son of god) = ilāhun : οὐδὲἐῴκει ἀνδρός γε θνητοῦ
πάϊς ἔμμεναι ἀλλὰθεοῖο Arist. Eth. Nic. VII 1, 1145a22 (= Iliad Ω 259) = wa-kāna
lā (lā cod. : mā Badawī yuẓannu bihī annahū bnun li-raǧulin (li-raǧulin cod. :
raǧul Badawī) mayyitin bal annahū (annahū cod. : ibnu Badawī) ilāhun 233.7*
Badawī.

προσηγόρευσαν Arist. Gener. anim. II 2, 736a20 = wa-qad sammawi l-ilāhata llatī
hiya rabbatu l-ǧimāʿi … li-ḥāli hāḏihi l-quwwati 62.9.

ayyuhā l-ilāh<at>u ʿalā l-saḫaṭati wa-l-ḥaradi (ayyuhā l-ilāh⟨at⟩u EDD. : annahu
l-ilāhu cod.; cf. Tkatsch ad loc.) 262.11* Tkatsch / fol. 141b11.

1. transl. θεῖος (of, from the god[s]; divine) and its derivatives in various uses

μένων ὑπὸτῆς θείας δυνάμεως … τιμιώτατον ἄνθρωπός ἐστι Alex. An. mant. [Lib.
arb.] 172.17 = inna l-insāna akramu l-ašyāʾi llatī tukawwinuhā wa-tuqawwimuhā
l-ʿināyatu l-ilāhiyyatu 193.4

om. codd. cett., ed.) Arist. Eth. Nic. X 8, 1179a24*= wa-ammā llaḏī yafʿalu bi-
ʿaqlin … fa-qad yušbihu an yakūna muḥabban li-llāhi ǧiddan 356.6Badawī/74.4
Axelroth.
2.5 φιλόθεος (lover of God, Allāh) : Arist. Rhet. II 17, 1391b2 = muḥibbun li-llāhi
128.19.
3. interpr.; τὸδαιμόνιον (divine being = Allāh) : ἔνθα καὶτὸτῶν εὐσεβῶν γένος
(γένοςed.:χῶρονasunderst.Arab.)ἐξόχωςἐτίμησετὸδαιμόνιον Ps.-Arist.Mund.6,
400b1* = ḥattā inna llāha taʿālā šahhara ḏālika l-makāna li-l-atqiyāʾi (li-l-atqiyāʾi
EDD.:bi-l-baqāʾied.)wa-ḫaṣṣahūbi-l-karāmati F105b11*=wa-huwal-mawḍiʿul-
karīmu ǧiddan wa-huwa mawḍiʿun li-l-ṣalāti wa-l-taʿabbudi … raḥmatan mina
llāhi Y 304a9–12 ( for the tradition of the myth of the εὐσεβῶν χῶρος referred to
here see Lycurgus Or. | in Leocr. §95; C. Rehdantz, ed., Lyc. p. 166f.; Fr. Wilhelm,
‘Zur Legende von den frommen Brüdern von Catina’, Philologus 80 [1924], 106–
109).
4. interpr. the Greek gods identified by name
4.1 Ἀπόλλων (Apollo = Allāh) : θεὸν ἐπόπτην καὶφύλακα πάντων νομίζων τὸν
Ἀπόλλωνα Artem. Onirocr. 203.6 = wa-anā muttakilun ʿalā llāhi annahu l-ḥāfiẓu
wa-l-muṭṭaliʿu ʿalā ǧamīʿi mā fīhā 365.13.
4.2 Ζεύς (Zeus = Allāh) : ὥσπερ ὕει ὁΖεύς Arist. Phys. II 8, 198b18 = ka-mā anna
l-maṭara yaʾtī llāhu bihī 144.3.
5. interpr. terms relating to Greek religion
5.1 σπονδή(libation to the gods) = sabbaḥa llāha in the compound word σπον-
δαυλέω (to play the flute at a libation) Artem. Onirocr. 63.10 = an yusabbiḥū llāha
fī ḏālika l-zamri 117.6. The transl. substituted for the pagan practice of ‘pouring
libation to the gods’ that of ‘singing in praise of God’ in the monotheistic religions.
5.2 μυστικώτερος (more secret; more connected with the Greek mysteries) =
ʿamila li-llāhi in οἱτὰμυστικώτερα πράττοντες (thosewhopracticethemoresecret
rites/activities) Artem. Onirocr. 11.13 = man kāna yaʿmalu li-llāhi tabāraka wa-
taʿāla 23.9.Thetransl.understoodμυστικώτεραtorefertotheGreekmysteries,and
the comparative form apparently to refer to the more specialized rites performed
by the priests rather than by lay initiates; he thus transl. the whole by ʿamila li-
llāhi, to work for or in the service of Allāh. Modern translators have understood
the reference to be to secret activities in general or to astrology in particular (Fes-
tugière p. 25).
6. interpr.(theol.); φιλάνθρωπος (humane,benevolent = endowedwithcompas-
sion by God, Allāh) = mā ǧaʿalahā llāhu ʿalayhi mina l-raḥmati : μηδένα φύεσθαι
δύναμιν ἔχοντα ψυχικὴν ἱκανὴν καταδέξασθαι τέχνηνοὕτω φιλάνθρωπον GalenMed.
phil. 3.20 = laysa aḥadun yakūnu fīhi min quwwati l-nafsi miqdārun kāfin fī
qabūli hāḏihi l-ṣināʿati ʿalā mā ǧaʿalahā llāhu ʿalayhi mina l-raḥmati 51 (where
a human attribute is presented as a gift from god).
●7. interpr.; ψάλλω Artem. Onirocr. 63.10 = istaʿmala mazāmīra llāhi 117.7. The
transl.understood ψάλλω(classicalGreek:toplayastringinstrumentwiththefin-
gers; Hellenistic Greek: to play the harp) in its Byzantine (Christian) Greek sense
(to sing psalms, the Psalms; cf. Lampe s.v., Vajda 90); mazāmīru llāhi (hymns or
psalms [in praise] of God) is to be contrasted with mazāmīru Dāwūda (Psalms of
David). |

A. Basic meaning: command, and its semantic extensions:
1.
command (maṣdar);
2–6.
command, authority, power, control.
B. 7–18.
Basic meaning: matter, thing, affair, case; pl. umūrun
C. Pronominal use: as generic substantive (‘thing’), renders or stands for Greek
19.
nouns,
20–24. pronouns,
25.
pronominal adjectives, and
26.
pronominal numerals;
D. 27–31. renders Greek prepositions indicating the object of concern or study;
E. sem.amplif.;standsforanomittedorimpliedsubstantiveintheGreek;thismay
be a substantive omitted after or implied by
32.
pronouns,
33.
predicate adjectives or adjectives used as substantives, and
34.
the nominal formation of the article followed by adjectives, adverbs,
participles, infinitives, verbal adjectives, prepositional phrases, and by
a noun in the gen.;
F. sem. amplif.; stands for an omitted or implied substantive in the Greek which is
the subject or object of verbs and verbal nouns, viz.
35.
for the implied object or objective complement of finite Greek verbs; |
36.
for the implicit object of verbal nouns or nouns with verbal force;
37.
sem. metathesis; for the implied Greek subject or object after transfor-
mations in voice and transitivity;
38.
for the subject of Greek impersonal verbs and predicates;
G. sem. amplif.; added in the translation of Greek adverbs and adverbial phrases
to express the concept of ‘state,’ ‘case,’ or ‘circumstances’ implicit in adverbs; it
appears in the translation of
39–42. temporal adverbs,
43.
adverbs of manner expressing comparison and similarity,
44.
adverbs and prepositional phrases expressive of a state;
H. sem. amplif.; added redundantly in the translation of Greek abstract and gen-
eral substantives to specify and individuate the sense of the Arabic word that
translates the Greek substantive; there are two such uses:
45.
partitive use of amr (i.e., not the thing itself but its amr), functioning
to specify an abstract or general substantive by drawing attention to
its ‘nature,’ or a ‘particular matter concerning’ it; the partitive sense is
thusthatwhatisatissueisnoteverythingabouttheconceptexpressed
by the substantive but only the specific aspect of it actually under dis-
cussion;
46.
individuating use of amr, helping to transl. abstract Greek nouns as
individual instances of the quality denoted by that noun; it functions
as a generic substantive, ‘thing,’ modified by an adjective or relative
clause which renders the sense of the Greek word actually translated;
I. 47–49. paraphrastic, periphrastic, and interpretive uses

1. transl. ἐλπίς (hope) and derivatives
1.1 ἐλπίζω (to hope) : δῆλον ὅτι καὶἡδοναὶμάλα (μάλα β Arab. [cf. Lyons p. 278] :
ἅμα A, ed.) μεμνημένοις καὶἐλπίζουσιν Arist. Rhet. I 11, 1370a31* = fa-huwa maʿlū-
mun anna l-laḏḏāti bi-ziyādatin li-l-ḏākirīna l-āmilīna 56.3; sim. 1370b9 = 56.19;
τὸτιμωρεῖσθαι … οἱ… ὀργιζόμενοι … ἐλπίζοντες … χαίρουσιν I11,1370b32 = fa-ammā
llaḏī yaġḍabu fa- … iḏā amala ḏālika (sc. al-aḫḏa bi-l-ṯaʾri) fariḥa 57.19.
1.2 ἐλπίς (hope) = mā yuʾmalu : τὰδ᾽ἐν ἐλπίδι (sc. ἡδέα) … ἢεὐφραίνειν ἢ
ὠφελεῖν Arist. Rhet. I 11, 1370b7 = wa-ammā llātī (sc. al-laḏīḏātu llātī) yuʾmalna
fa-hunna llātī … yasrurna aw yanfaʿna 56.16; ἀνάγκη … πάσῃὀργῇἕπεσθαίτινα
ἡδονὴν τὴν ἀπὸτῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦτιμωρήσασθαι II 2, 1378b2 = lā budda … an yalzama
kulla ġaḍabin šayʾun mina l-laḏḏati min qibali annahū yuʾmalu an yantaqima
84.4.
2. προσδέχομαι (to expect) : ἐὰν τἀναντία τύχῃπροσδεχόμενος Arist. Rhet. II 2,
1379a23 = in ṣāra ilā ḫilāfi mā amala 86.22.
3. βούλομαι w. acc. (to wish, to like) : λυπεῖγὰρ μᾶλλον τὸπολὺπαρὰδόξαν
(ὥσπερκαὶτέρπειτὸπολὺπαρὰδόξανom.Arab.throughhomoioteleuton;cr.Lyons
p.304)ἐὰνγένηται(μὴγένηταιasunderst.Arab.oritsexemplarbecauseof thelac.)
ὃβούλεται Arist. Rhet. II 2, 1379a25* = fa-qad yaʿriḍu li-l-marʾi l-aḏā wa-l-ḥuznu
l-šadīdu bi-l-akṯari iḏā ẓanna ẓannan wa-lam yakun mā amala 86.23.
4. sem. metathesis; impersonal / personal transformation : impersonal προσή-
κει w. inf. (it is fitting, expected [that s.th. be the case]) = amala w. an (he expects
that[s.th.isthecase]) : ἐλεεινόν … καὶτὸὅθεν προσῆκεν ἀγαθόν τι ὑπάρξαι, κακόν τι
συμβῆναι Arist. Rhet. II 8, 1386a12 = ṯumma min ḏālika (sc. min fāʿilāti l-hammi)
| ayḍan an yaṣīra l-marʾu ilā šarrin ⟨mina⟩l-šurūri (šarrin ⟨mina⟩l-šurūri EDD. :
šarri l-šarri cod. : šarri secl. Badawī : fiʿli l-šarri conj. Lyons) min ḥayṯu yaʾmulu
an yanālahū ḫayrun 110.18*.
5. periphr. τὸἐρωμένον (the beloved) = allaḏī yuʾmalu (what is hoped for) :
καὶοἱἐρ⟨ωτ⟩ῶντες (sic Arab.! cf. Lyons p. 279) … αἰεὶπερὶτοῦἐρωμένου χαίρουσιν
Arist. Rhet. I 11, 1370b20* = wa-llaḏīna yasʾalūna … qad yafraḥūna abadan bi-llātī
yaʾmulūna 57.6 (the periphrasis is caused by the wrong transl. of ἐρῶντες at the
beginning of the sentence); sim. 1370b22 = 57.8.

Arab. : κἂν β : καὶἐν Arnet,ed.) τῷμεμνημένῳκαὶτῷἐλπίζοντι ἀκολουθοῖἂν φαντα-
σίατις·(thuspunctuatedArab.)οὐμέμνηταιἢ(οὐκvelοὐδέasunderst.Arab.)ἐλπί-
ζει Arist. Rhet. II 11, 1370a29–30* = fa-ammā l-taḫayyulu fa-huwa ḥissun ḍaʿīfun,
yatawahhamu abadan bi-l-ḏikri wa-l-taʾmīli; wa-ʿinda (wa-ʿinda EDD. : wa-qad

consequitur privationem memorationis privatio spei) 56.1–2*; ἢἐν τῷἐλπίζειν
μέλλοντα (sc. τὰἡδέα)· … ἐλπίζουσι δὲτὰμέλλοντα 1370a34–35 = wa-immā ⟨iḏā⟩
(suppl. Badawī) kunna yutawaqqaʿna (sc. al-laḏīḏātu) fa-fī l-taʾmīli fa-inna … l-
taʾmīla li-l-kāʾināti 56.6–7.

(sc. οἱπρεσβύτεροι) διὰτὴν ἐμπειρίαν Arist.Rhet.II13,1390a4 = ṯumma hum (hum
[sc. al-šuyūḫu] conj. Lyons : huwa cod.) ʿasura taʾmīluhum li-kaṯrati taǧāribihim
124.6*.

ἀθληταῖς … παισὶμὲν οὐκ ἐπίσημον διὰτὴν τῆς ἐγκρίσεως προσδοκίαν (προσδοκίαν
L Arab. : ἡλικίαν Ved., cf. Pack 1976 pp. 309–310) Artem. Onirocr. 66.12* = fa-in raʾā
l-insānu ka-annahū yumtaḥanu fī l-ṣirāʿi fa- … aḥdāṯu l-muṣāriʿīna lā yuḥmadu
fīhim li-mā yuʾammilūnahū min annahū yuḥkamu lahum bi-l-ġalabati 123.3. |

1.1 σκοπέω (to contemplate, to consider) : δῆλόν τε σκοποῦσιν ὡς τιθέασιν αὐτὴν
ἔνιοι Arist. Phys. III 2, 201b19 = wa-li-anna ṣawāba qawlinā tabayyana (tabayyana
EDD.:yubayyanued.)li-mantaʾammalaamrahāʿalāḥasabimāwaḍaʿahāʿalayhi
qawmun āḫarūna 182.8*
▬
πρὸς τὸαὑτῶν σκοπούμενοι (sc. οἱκριταί) Arist.
Rhet. I 1, 1354b34 = wa-yutaʾammalu mā yakūnu minhum (sc. mina l-ḥukkāmi)
4.11; σκοπεῖν τὰπερὶτὴν δύναμιν II 17, 1391a26 = yataʾammalūna afʿāla l-quwwati
128.9

mina l-wāḥidi 100.7.

τούτοις ἀκολουθοῦντα ἐπισκοπεῖν δεῖArist. Int. 13, 23a20* = ṯumma yanbaġī an
nataʾammala kayfa (⟨yakūnu⟩add. Badawī) luzūmu sāʾiri tilka l-bāqiyati li-
hāḏihī 129.10/fol.190a10
▬ὅταν μέντοι γε τῶν ἁπλῶν τι σημαινομένων ἐπισκοπῇ
(sc. ὁνοῦς) … ἥκιστα μὲν διαψεύδεται Them. In De an. 112.14 = illā annahū (sc. al-
ʿaqla) ʿinda taʾammulihī li-šayʾin mina l-maʿānī l-basīṭati … fa-qalla mā yakḏibu
205.2.
2. θεωρέω (to observe, to regard) : θεωρείσθω δὲἐκ τῆς ὑπογραφῆς ὡς λέγο-
μεν Arist. Int. 13, 22a22 = fal-yutaʾammal (yutaʾammal EDD. : nataʾammal ed.)
mā naṣifuhū min hāḏā l-rasmi llaḏī narsumuhū 125.12* / fol. 188b11
▬
ἀντι-
κειμένων δὴἀλλήλοις τῶν δύο τούτων εἰδῶν … τρίτον ἀνὰμέσον τι θεωρεῖται, οἱονεὶ
ἐξ ἀμφοτέρων εἰδοποιούμενον, τὸκατ᾽αὐτὸ(κατ᾽αὐτὸm Arab. : καθ᾽αὑτὸcodd.
cett.,ed.)μὲνδεύτερονκαὶσύνθετον Nicom.| Arithm.29.1*=fa-hāḏānil-nawʿāni…
nawʿāni mutaqābilāni wa-qad yūǧadu … nawʿun āḫaru ṯāliṯun fī-mā baynahā
(sic ed. for baynahumā) bi-manzilati l-šayʾi l-maʿmūli minhumā ǧamīʿan wa-
huwa nawʿun matā taʾammalahu l-mutaʾammilu mufradan waǧadahū ṯāniyan
murakkaban 31.6ⓧ.
3. transl. ὁράω (to see, to discern) and compounds
3.1 ὁράω (to see, to discern) = in hend. naẓara ilā wa-taʾammala : ἔμελλον καὶ
περὶτῶνκατὰμέρος,οἷαἐντί,καλῶςὀψεῖσθαι Nicom.Arithm.6.22(= ArchytasHar-
monica, fr. B1, Diels/Kranz I 432.4) = wa-ka-ḏālika ayḍani l-ṭabāʾiʿa l-ǧuzʾiyyata
(sc. naʿlamuhā) iḏā ṣaḥḥaḥnā l-naẓara ilayhā wa-taʾammalnāhā 14.21.
3.2 ἐνοράω (to look at, observe) : καίμοι παραστάντι σοι εὐθέως μὲν φιλικοῖς ἐνεῖ-
δες τοῖς ὄμμασι Galen Ther. Pis. 211.4 = fa-lammā danawtu minka rafaʿta ilayya
ṭarfaka wa-taʾammaltanī taʾammula l-muḥibbi 104a1.
4. προσέχω (to turn ones consideration, attention to; to inspect) (a) abs. :
προσέχουσι γὰρ μᾶλλον τούτοις: προσεκτικοὶδὲτοῖς μεγάλοις (thus punctuated
Arab.) Arist. Rhet. III 14, 1415a38 = fa-innahum yataʾammalūna bi-ziyādatini
llaḏīna hum aḥrā an yutaqarraba minhum, aʿnī l-ʿuẓamāʾa 205.19 (b) in hend.
taʾammala wa-tafaqqada : ὅτε μάλιστα πάντες προσέχοντες ἀκροῶνται Arist. Rhet.
III 14, 1415b11 = wa-lā siyyamā iḏā hum taʾammalū wa-tafaqqadū mā yasmaʿūna
206.6.

5.1 λαμβάνω (to take up [ for consideration]) : ἔτι δὲκαὶκαθ᾽ἑκάστην λαμβά-
νουσι (sc. τὰς μεταβολάς) φανερόν Arist. Phys. VI 5, 235b19 = wa-ayḍan fa-inna
ḏālika qad yaẓharu li-man taʾammala ṣinfan ṣinfan mina l-taġayyuri 668.19.
5.2 καταλαμβάνω or -ομαι med. (to apprehend) : καὶθείῳψυχῆς ὄμματι τὰ
θεῖα καταλαβομένη (καταλαβοῦσα PZ; sc. ἡψυχή) Ps.-Arist. Mund. 1, 391a15 = iḏ
tataʾammalu (sc. al-nafsu) bi-ʿayni luṭfihā ⟨l-⟩umūra l-ilāhiyyata (read thus)
F 86b11*.
6.ἐπιβλέπω(tolookupon,takeintoconsideration):ἔκτεδὴτούτωνπιστεύσειεν
ἄν τις εἶναίτι πρῶτον ἀκίνητον, καὶπάλιν ἐπιβλέψας ἐπὶτὰς ἀρχάς τῶν κινούντων
(τῶν κινούντων ΠPS Arab., Hardie and Gaye in Arist. CWA p. 433 : secl. Ross) Arist.
Phys. VIII 6, 259a21* = fa-min hāḏihi l-ašyāʾi yaṯiqu l-insānu bi-anna | hāhunā
šayʾan awwalan ġayra mutaḥarrikin wa-qad yaṯiqu bi-ḏālika ayḍan iḏā huwa
taʾammala mabādiʾa l-ḥarakāti 869.6.
7.νοέω(tothink,toenvisage):δι᾽ὧν(sc.τῶνδύοπόλων)εἰνοήσαιμενἐπεζευγμέ-
νην εὐθεῖαν, ἥν τινες ἄξονα καλοῦσι, διάμετρος ἔσται τοῦκόσμου Ps.-Arist. Mund. 2,
391b26 = wa-l-falaku lahū miḥwarun … fa-iḏā taʾammalta raʾayta l-miḥwara ka-
annahū nāfiḏun ilā l-ṭarafayni kilāhumā (sic cod. for kilayhimā : ka-lāzimihimā
ed.) K 183b6*ⓧ.
8. ἀτενίζω, sc. τὴν διάνοιαν (to look intently, concentrate [one’s mind on]) =
taʾammala bi-ḏihnihī : ἡδ᾽ἑτέρα μοῖρα τῆς ἐναντιώσεως πολλάκις ἂν φαντασθείη
τῷπρὸς τὸκακοποιὸν αὐτῆς ἀτενίζοντι τὴν διάνοιαν οὐδ᾽εἶναι τὸπαράπαν Arist.
Phys. I 9, 192a15 = wa-ammā hāḏihi l-ṭabīʿatu l-uḫrā llatī hiya aḥadu ǧuzʾayi
l-muḍāddati fa-kaṯīran mā yuḫayyalu li-man taʾammala bi-ḏihnihī sūʾa fiʿlihā
annahā laysati l-battata 74.1.
9. paraphr. ἐφαρμόζω math. (to apply [properties of some numbers to oth-
ers]) : καὶπάντα τὰπρολεχθέντα ἰδιώματα ἐφαρμόζων σύμφωνα εὑρήσεις Nicom.
Arithm. 139.20 = wa-iḏā anta taʾammalta, fī hāḏihi l-aʿdādi, sāʾira ḫawāṣṣi hāḏā
l-tawassuṭi llatī qaddamnā ḏikrahā waǧadtahā lāzimatan lahā 107.13.

entries.body_text:
1. sem. metathesis; affirm. / neg. transformation : κίνδυνος (sc. ἐστί) (there is
risk) = lam taʾman (you are not safe) : ἢν γὰρ μεταβάλλῃταχέως τὴν δίαιταν, κίν-
δυνος καὶἀπὸτῆς μεταβολῆς νεώτερόν τι γενέσθαι ἐν τῷσώματι Hippocr. Nat. hom.
192.1 = wa-ḏālika annaka matā naqalta l-tadbīra ilā l-ḍiddi baġtatan lam taʾman
an yaḥduṯa ʿalā l-badani bi-sababi ḏālika l-intiqāli amrun ǧadīdun 17.13.
2. sem. metathesis; affirm. / neg. transformation : εἴωθε πλανᾶν (is wont to mis-
lead) = laysa yuʾmanu l-ḫaṭaʾu (there is no freedom from fear of a mistake) : εἰμή
τις ἔμπειρος εἴη περὶτὴν κρίσιν, πλανᾶν (readthus) εἴωθε (sc. ἡκασσία) GalenTher.
Pis. 258.4 = fa-iḏā lam yaʿrifhā (sc. al-salīḫata) l-insānu maʿrifatan yaṯiqu bihā
fa-laysa yuʾmanu (read thus for yuʾammi/anu ed.) ʿalayhi l-ḫaṭaʾu fīmā yaḫtāru
minhā 119a15*.
3. paraphr. and sem. metathesis; affirm. / neg. transformation : ῥᾳδίως ([s.th.
happens] easily) = lā yuʾmanu an (there is no freedom | from fear that [s.th. will
happen]) : καὶδιαλύει (sc. τὸφάρμακον) ῥᾳδίως τὸσῶμα καὶτὸἔμφυτον πνεῦμα
ταχέως σβέννυσιν GalenTher.Pis.286.8 = fa-lā yuʾmanu an yaḥulla (sc. al-dawāʾu)
abdānahum sarīʿan wa-yuṭfiʾa ḥarāratahumu l-ġarīziyyata 128a1.

1. θεράπαινα (handmaid) : λεκάνη οἰκέτην σημαίνει καὶθεράπαιναν πιστούς.
πίνειν δὲἐκ λεκάνης ἐρασθῆναι θεραπαίνης σημαίνει Artem. Onirocr. 217.1,2 = al-
luqūnu fī l-ruʾyā tadullu ʿalā mamlūkin aw amatin ḏaway amānatin. fa-in raʾā
l-insānu ka-annahū yašrabu mina l-laqani fa-inna ḏālika yadullu ʿalā annahū
yuṣādiqu amatan mina l-imāʾi 394.12,14; 217.4,7 = 395.1,4.
2. δούλη (bondwoman) : καὶκατὰπόλιν μήτε δούλην μήτε δοῦλον (sic Arab.,
Plato Laws : ⟨μήτε δοῦλον⟩μήτε δούλην ed.) γεύεσθαι (sc. οἴνου) μηδέποτε Galen
An.virt.70.2* (=PlatoLaws674a7) = wa-fī l-madīnati lā yaḏūquhū (sc. al-šarāba)
fī šayʾin mina l-awqāti lā amatun wa-lā ʿabdun 36.18.
3. οἰκέτις ( female household slave) (a) abs. : γυναικὸς οἰκείης (after οἰκείης
Arab. codd. I and M add οἰκέτις from Galen’s comm. : οἰκέτις for οἰκείης Galen)
ταωνουργὸς(orΤΑΩCΟΕΡΓΟCasunderst.Arab.for ΜΟΥCΟΕΡΓΟCed.[Mattock
&Lyons,p.93]) ἦν Hippocr.Nat.puer.55.8* = kānati mraʾatun [amatun] (amatun
add. M from Galen’s comm. : umayyatun add. I from Galen’s comm. : om. G : secl.
EDD.) li-baʿḍi ǧīrānī (li-baʿḍi ǧīrānī G : li-ǧīrānin lī IM) taʿmalu l-marāwiḥa min
rīši l-ṭawāwīsi 49.3* (the original transl., as represented by MS G and reproduced
here, rendered the Hippocratic text: kānati mraʾatun li-baʿḍi ǧīrānī …; the redac-
tor of the Arabic transl. as represented by MSS I and M contaminated it with the
Galenic commentary, which reads οἰκέτις for οἰκείης, and instead of substitut-
ing the one word for the other, added the word amatun [οἰκέτις], possibly from
a marginal note, into the text without eliminating li-baʿḍi ǧīrānī [οἰκείης]) (b)
in hend. walīdatun wa-amatun : μέγα δὲτεκμήριον αἱοἰκέτιδες κυέουσαι (κυέου-
σαι or sim. Arab. : ποιεῦσιν codd. : del.Wilamowitz) Hippocr. Aer. 72.7* = inna min
akbari (akbari EDD. : akṯari ed.) amārāti mā ḏakarnā surʿata štimāli l-walāʾidi
wa-l-imāʾi 147.13*.
4. οἰκονόμος (stewardess,handmaidwhomanagesahousehold) : ἀπώλειαν (sc.
σημαίνει) τῶν πιστευομένων κατὰτὸν οἶκον, | γυναικὸς λέγω ἢοἰκονόμου Artem.
Onirocr. 107.15 = dalīluhū ʿalā halāki l-muʾtamanīna ʿalā bayti l-raǧuli miṯla
mraʾati l-raǧuli wa-imāʾihī (wa-imāʾihī cod. : ⟨a⟩w uma⟨n⟩āʾihī [!] Fahd) 198.4*.

γὰρ τὸθηρίον ὑπόξανθον, καὶἐπὶτῇκεφαλῇτρεῖς ὑπεροχὰς ἔχον, ὥς φασιν Galen
Ther. Pis. 233.15–17 ≅fa-min ḏālika l-ḥayyatu llatī tusammā basīlisqus … yuḫbiru
ʿanhā man yaʿrifuhā annahā šaqrāʾu ʿalā raʾsihā ṯalāṯu qanāziʿa 111a16–b1.
C. paraphr. and periphr.; introduces a nominal clause in various paraphrastic
and periphrastic renderings; e.g.
11. paraphr. ἴσως adv. (perhaps) = yaẓharu annahū : ὁδὲνοῦς ἴσως θειότερόν τι
καὶἀπαθές ἐστιν Arist. De an. I 4, 408b29 = fa-ammā l-ʿaqlu fa-yaẓharu annahū
rūḥāniyyun lā yaʾlamu 20.19.
12. paraphr. μᾶλλον adv. (rather, much more) = al-awlā annahū : ἐπὶδὲτῶν
δευτέρων οὐσιῶν … οὐμὴν ἀληθές γε, ἀλλὰμᾶλλον ποιόν τι σημαίνει Arist. Cat.
5, 3b15 = wa-ammā l-ǧawāhiru l-ṯawānī fa- … laysa ḏālika ḥaqqan bali l-awlā
annahā tadullu ʿalā ayyi šayʾin 40.12 / fol. 163a15.
13. periphr.; introduces a nominal clause that transl. an interrog. subj. in indi-
rect discourse like an inf.; ὑποψία … ᾖ(suspicion that it might be) = al-ẓannu …
annahū (assumption that it is) : τοῦτο μὲν οὖν ἤδη καὶὑποψίαν τινὰφέρει μεγάλην
ὅλῃτῇτῆς ψυχῆς οὐσίᾳ, μὴοὐκ ἀσώματος ᾖGalen An. virt. 48.22 = wa-fī ḏālika mā
yadʿū ilā l-ẓanni bi-kulli ǧawhari l-nafsi annahū laysa ġayra ǧismin 22.4.
14. periphr.; introduces a subject nominal clause that transl. the protasis of
Greek conditional or temporal sentences; the apodosis then is rendered as the
predicate of the nominal clause : εἰγὰρ καὶμόνος ὁοἶνος μιχθεὶς τοῖς θηρίοις τὸν
ἀπ᾽αὐτῶν τῶν θηρίων κίνδυνον ἐκφεύγειν ποιεῖ, δηλονότι καὶἡθηριακὴ… παιώνιόν
τι φάρμακον μᾶλλον Galen Ther. Pis. 248.18–249.4 ≅wa-mimmā yadʿū ilā taṣdīqi
qawlī fī l-tiryāqi anna l-ḫamra faqaṭiḏā unqiʿat fīhā l-afāʿī tanfaʿu min ladġi l-
hawāmmi fa-l-tiryāqu aḥrā an yanfaʿa 116b1–3; θαυμάζειν δὲἔστι τὴν ἀντίδοτον,
ὅταν μὴμόνον αὐτὴν πάσχον θεραπεύουσαν βλέπωμεν, ἀλλὰκαὶ… ὠφελεῖν δυνα-
μένην 276.17ff. ≅wa-mimmā yanbaġī an yuʿǧaba minhu min | hāḏā l-maʿǧūni
annahū ka-mā tarāhu yanfaʿu l-badana ka-ḏālika qad yanfaʿu … ayḍan 125a8ff.
D. nominal derivatives of anna as philosophical technical terms
(NB: For the origin, usage, and development of this philosophical terminology
v. R.M. Frank in Cahiers de Byrsa6, 1956,181–201[repr.in D.Gutas,ed.,Philosophy,
Theology and Mysticism in Medieval Islam, by R.M. Frank,Vol. I, Aldershot 2005],
and G. Endress, Proclus Arabus 77–109, with references to further literature.)

A. as a conditional or interrogative conjunction (basic meaning: ‘if’), in may
translate, in an Arabic sentence retaining the structure of the Greek syntax,
a discrete Greek word with a conditional meaning, or a temporal meaning with
a conditional implication; i.e., it may translate
1. a conditional particle
2. a temporal conjunction with a conditional implication,
3. an interrogative conjunction introducing indirect questions (basic meaning
‘whether’); also,
4. in an antithetical context, in … wa-in / in … aw may translate antithetical
conjunctions or particles (basic meaning: ‘be it … or [be it]’);
5. with sem. amplif.: conditional particles, while also emphasizing the inferen-
tial evidence by re-stating or supplying a previous conclusion, and
6. with sem. amplif.: inferentialGreekwords,byrestatingorsupplying the con-
dition implied in the text; the text of the in-clause may consist of
6.1
a generic formula,
6.2
a conditional clause specific to the context.

renders

entries.body_text:
1. ὄρχις and pl. ὄρχεις (testicles) : ἔχει δὲτὰπερὶτοὺς ὄρχεις καὶτὰς ὑστέρας
οὐχ ὁμοίως πᾶσι τοῖς ἐναίμοις ζῴοις, καὶπρῶτόν γε τὰπερὶτοὺς ὄρχεις τοῖς ἄρρεσιν
Arist. Gener. anim. I 3, 716b13, 15 = wa-ḥālu l-unṯayayni wa-l-arḥāmi muḫtali-
fun laysa bi-mutašābihin fī ǧamīʿi l-ḥayawāni l-damiyyi wa-awwalu l-iḫtilāfi fī
unṯayayi (read thus) l-ḏukūrati 5.15–16*; 716b15–32 = 5.17–16.9; I 4, 717a14–b13 =
7.3–8.14;IV1,765a23 = 138.4(v.above unṯā 1.3.1c); etc.
▬
τοῖσίτε παιδίοισιν ὕδρω-
πεςἐγγίνονταιἐντοῖσινὄρχεσιν Hippocr.Aer.32.4=wa-l-ṣibyānu…minahlihāḏihi
l-madīnati yaʿriḍu lahumu l-māʾu l-aṣfaru … fī l-unṯayayni version B 33.13, sim.
version A 33.5
▬
σημεῖα τούτου (τούτου Arab. : ταῦτ᾽ed.) ἐν τῇσιν ἡλικίῃσι … τὰ
πρὸς ὄρχιν Hippocr. Humor. 10.11* = wa-l-dalīlu ʿalā hāḏā mā yaʿriḍu fī l-asnāni …
mini ntiqāli l-ʿillati ilā l-unṯayayni 23.4
▬φέρουσιν (sc. αἱφλέβες) παρὰτὰς
ψόας ἐς τοὺς ὄρχιας Hippocr. Nat. hom. 194.7 = ilā an yabluġa (sc. zawǧu l-ʿurūqi)
ilā l-ḫawāṣiri ṯumma yanqasimu min hunāka fī l-unṯayayni 19.5; δεῖοὖν τὰς φλε-
βοτομίας ποιεῖσθαι πρὸς τὰς ὀδύνας τὰς ἀπὸ… τῶν ὀρχίων ἀπὸτῶν ἰγνύων 194.10 =
fa-qadyanbaġīli-manarādafaṣdal-ʿirqifīawǧāʿi…l-unṯayaynianyafṣidal-ʿirqa
llaḏī yaẓharu taḥta l-rukbati 19.8
▬
cf. also WGAÜ, 475.2-4.
2. δίδυμοι (twins, metaph. for the testicles; v. LSJ s.v. III.2) : τὰφύλλα … σκληρίας
τε διδύμων … μαλάττει Diosc. Mat. med. I, 96.5 = wa-waraquhū … layyana ǧasāʾa
l-unṯayayni Ibn al-Bayṭār Ǧāmiʿ I, 116.20; αὐτὰδὲτὰφύλλα λεῖα καταπλασσόμενα
ἐν ὕδατι ἁρμόζει … διδύμων τε φλεγμοναῖς καὶἐπινυκτίσι I, 106.6 = wa-l-waraqu iḏā
duqqa wa-suḥiqa wa-ṣubba ʿalayhi māʾun … wāfaqa … l-ḥumrata wa-l-awrāma
l-ḥārrata l-ʿāriḍata li-l-unṯayayni I, 28.17.
! 3. αἰδοῖον and pl. αἰδοῖα (genitals) : διὸἔχουσιν αἰδοῖα τὰτοιαῦτα πάντα καὶτὰ
ἄρρενα καὶτὰθήλεα καθ᾽ἃἐκκρίνεται | τὸπερίττωμα τὸὑγρόν Arist. Gener. anim.
I13,719b30–31 = wa-li-ḏālika tūǧadu fīhi unṯayāni aʿnī fī l-ḏukūrati wa-l-ināṯi wa-
fī l-unṯayayni sabīlun taḫruǧu (or tuḫraǧu?) minhā ruṭūbatun ⟨faḍlatun⟩(EDD.;
lac.ind.Brugman)16.4–5*; οὐθὲν γὰρ ἔχει τούτων αἰδοῖον 720a24 = li-annahū laysa
li-šayʾin min hāḏā l-ṣinfi unṯayāni 17.7; καὶτὰτῶν αἰδοίων (sc. μέρη) πῶς; I 18,
722b5 = wa-kayfa takūnu ḥālu l-unṯayayni 23.21; II 4, 737b31 = 66.18
▬
cf. also
WGAÜ, 79.10-11.

entries.lemma_raw: أنْسI. unsun maṣdar or subst. of ana/i/usa ( for the views of classical lexicogra-
entries.body_text:
phers v. Lane 113 s.v.)
1. transl. εὔνοια (goodwill, amicability) and derivatives
1.1 εὔνοια (amicability) = in hend. ilfun aw unsun : περὶδ᾽εὐνοίας καὶφιλίας …
λεκτέον Arist. Rhet. II 1, 1378a19 = wa-ammā l-ilfu awi l-unsu wa-l-ṣadāqatu fa-
innā qāʾilūna fīhā 83.9.
1.2 εὔνουν ποιεῖν (to secure s.o.’s goodwill) = annasa awi-ḥtāla li-l-unsi v. below
annasa 1b.
? 2. εὐμάθεια (readiness to learn, docility) : εἰς δὲεὐμάθειαν ἅπαντα ἀνάξει, ἐάν
τιςβούληταικαὶτὸἐπιεικῆφαίνεσθαι Arist.Rhet.III14,1415a37=wa-ammāli-l-unsi
fa-yuḥḍiru (perhaps read fa-yuḥḍiruhū) kullu šayʾin šarīfin aw nafīsin wa-ka-
ḏālika in arāda l-marʾu an yaṯbuta annahū ḫayrun 205.17* (uns for εὐμάθεια is
problematic [in 1362b24 it is translated as taʿallum] : here it could be explained by
the context and by the preceding yuʾannisa [p. 205.14] which renders εὔνουν ποι-
ῆσαι [1415a34, v. below annasa 1a]; or by a possible Syriac intermediary: v. Lyons
pp. 388–389; or less plausibly by assuming εὐμένεια for εὐμάθεια in the Greek
archetype, either in the text or as a gloss).

entries.body_text:
1. transl. τιθασσεύω (to tame) and derivatives
1.1 τιθασσεύομαι pass. (to be tamed) (a) abs. : ταχέως δὲμετὰταῦτα τιθασ-
σεύεταίτε (sc. ὁἐλέφας) καὶπειθαρχεῖArist. Hist. anim. IX 1, 610a29 = fa-huwa
(sc. al-fīlu) yastaʾnisu wa-yakūnu muṭīʿan li-l-sāʾisi ʿāǧilan 380.16
(b) in hend.
kāsa wa-staʾnasa : μαλακώτερον γὰρ τὸἦθός (εἶδος appar. as underst. Arab.) ἐστι
τῶν θηλειῶν, καὶτιθασσεύεται θᾶττον Arist. Hist. anim. IX 1, 608a25–26* = fa-inna
šakla l-ināṯi alyanu wa-aḍʿafu wa-hiya takīsu (read thus) wa-tastaʾnisu … ʿāǧilan
372.9*.
1.2 τιθασσός (tame, tamed) = allaḏī staʾnasa : καὶγὰρ ἐπὶτῶν ἐλάφων ὦπται
τοῦτο συμβαῖνον τῶν γε τιθασσῶν Arist. Hist. anim. V 2, 540a8 = wa-qad ẓahara
ḏālika l-ʿaraḍu fī l-ayyilati llatī staʾnasat 205.4; v. below istaʾnasa 2.2. |
1.3 sem. concentr.; τιθασσὸς γίνεται (to become tamed) : ἐλάττων μὲν οὖν ἡ
πελειάς, τιθασσὸν δὲγίνεται μᾶλλον ἡπεριστεράArist. Hist. anim. V 13, 544b2–3 =
bāliyās (read thus : bi-l-nās cod. : pālayā Badawī) : wa-hiya fī l-ǧuṯṯati aṣġaru
mina l-ḥamāmati (read thus), wa-laysa yastaʾnisu bāliyās (as before) miṯla l-
ḥamāmati 222.12*.
1.4 sem. concentr.; τιθασσῶς ἔχειν (to behave in a tame manner) : κινδυνεύει δὲ
(sc. εἰἀφθονία τροφῆς εἴη) πρός τε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἂν ἔχειν τιθασσῶς τὰ… ἀγριαί-
νοντα Arist. Hist. anim. IX 1, 608b31 = takādu l-sibāʿu wa-l-ḥayawānu tastaʾnisu
ilā l-nāsi 374.15.
1.5 sem.; etym.; τιθασσευτικός (easy to tame) = in hend. kāsa wa-staʾnasa sa-
rīʿan : τὰδὲ(sc. τῶν ζῴων) πρᾶα καὶτιθασσευτικά, οἷον ἐλέφας Arist. Hist. anim.
I 1, 488b22 = wa-baʿḍuhā (sc. al-ḥayawāni) wadīʿun yakīsu wa-yastaʾnisu sarīʿan
miṯla l-fīli 16.14.
2. transl. ἡμερόω (to tame, to domesticate) and derivatives
2.1 ἡμεροῦμαι pass. (to be tamed, domesticated) : τὰδὲ(sc. τῶν ἀγρίων) καὶ
ἡμεροῦσθαι δύναται ταχύArist. Hist. anim. I 1, 488a29 = wa-mina l-waḥšiyyati mā
yastaʾnisu ʿāǧilan 15.2; ὅσα δ᾽(sc. τῶν ὀρνέων) ἢἥμερα ἢἡμεροῦσθαι δύναται, ταῦτα
δὲπλεονάκις (sc. τίκτει) V 13, 544a30 = fa-ammā mā kāna mina l-ṭayri l-anīsi awi
llaḏī yumkinu an yastaʾnisa fa-huwa yabīḍu mirāran šattā 222.8.
2.2sem.;etym.;ἡμερώτατος(mosteasilytamed)=istaʾnasaʿāǧilanakṯara:πάν-

contraction of unāsun, v. the following entry)
1. ἄνθρωποι (human beings) : πάλιν ἐν μὲν τῇκώμῃπολλούς φαμεν ἀνθρώ-
πους εἶναι Arist. Cat. 6, 5b23 = wa-ayḍan qad naqūlu inna fī l-qaryati unāsan
(Ayṯīniyaadd.Badawī : om.MS,ed.Georr) kaṯīran (siced.for kaṯīrīna or kiṯāran)
46.7*ⓧ/ fol. 164b12
▬
ἄκανθαι καὶσκόλοπες … πολλοῖς δὲκαὶἔρωτας καὶἀδι-
κίας ὑπὸἀνθρώπων πονηρῶν (sc. σημαίνουσι) Artem. Onirocr. 218.6 = al-šawku
wa-l-awtādu … tadullu fī kaṯīrin mina l-nāsi ʿalā ʿišqin wa-ẓulmin yaʿriḍu lahum
min unāsi sawʾin 397.9; 218.7 = 397.11; 211.19 = 383.6
▬ἐναργῶς πάλιν ἐνταῦθα
γεννᾶν τοὺς τόπους φησὶν ἀμείνους τε καὶχείρους ἀνθρώπους Galen An. virt. 66.1 =
wa-hāhunā ayḍan qad bayyana fī qawlihī anna l-mawāḍiʿa tuwallidu unāsan
akṯara faḍīlatan wa-aqalla faḍīlatan 34.1.
2. πρόσωπα (persons, individuals) : ἀγριαίνοντες δὲ(sc. οἱκύνες) ἢὑλακτοῦντες
(ἢδάκνοντες add. L, ed. : om. V Arab.) ἀδικίας τὰς ἀπὸτῶν τοιούτων μαντεύονται
προσώπων Artem. Onirocr. 118.13* = fa-ammā iḏā raʾāhā (sc. al-kilāba) kalibatan
aw nabbāḥatan fa-innahā tadullu ʿalā maḍarratin takūnu min unāsi sawʾin
216.3 (where sawʾ is the translator’s interpretation of τοιούτων, influenced by the
absence of τοῖς προειρημένοις in 118.10 from his exemplar [as in MS V] and the
presence of ἀδικίας in this sentence).
3. sem. concentr.; ἄνδρες ἢγυναῖκες (men or women, i.e., people) : ἀλλότριοι δὲ
κύνες σαίνοντες μὲν δόλους καὶἐνέδρας ⟨ἀπὸ⟩πονηρῶν ἀνδρῶν ἢγυναικῶν σημαί-
νουσι Artem. Onirocr. 118.14–15 = fa-in raʾā l-insānu kilāban ġarībatan tataqad-
damu ilayhi fa-innahā tadullu ʿalā makrin yakūnu lahū min unāsi šarrin 216.5
▬
ἐξ οὗ(sc. τοῦθεοῦ) … δένδρεάτ᾽ἐβλάστησε καὶἀνέρες ἠδὲγυναῖκες Ps.-Arist.
Mund. 6, 399b27 (= Empedocles fr. 21, Diels/Kranz I, 320.5) = wa-minhu (sc. mina
llāhi) asbābuhū (sc. al-ʿālami kullihī) … mina l-insi … wa-l-ašǧāri F 104b1.
4. τινες (some people) : ὥστε διὰταῦτα τῶν σοφιστῶν τινὲς … προεπηλάκι-
ζεν αὐτάς (sc. τὰς αἰτίας, as underst. Arab.) Arist. Metaph. Β 2, 996a32 = wa-li-
ḏālika kāna unāsun mina l-sūfisṭāʾiyyīna (read thus) yarfuḍūna hāḏihi l-ʿillata
(perhaps al-ʿilala?) 184.6*
▬
καὶτινὲς (καὶτινὲς or καίτινες Arab. : καὶτίνες
ed.) εὔρυθμον ποιοῦσι ῥυθμόν (ῥυθμόν β Arab. : ῥυθμοίA, ed.) Arist. Rhet. III 8,
1409a22* = fa-ammā unāsun fa-yaǧʿalūna l-wazna kullahū ḥasana l-nabarāti
194.12
▬ὅθεν καὶ| τὸν Νέστορα βούλονταίτινες ἐνενηκονταετῆγεγονέναι Artem.
Onirocr. 197.4 = wa-li-ḏālika qāla unāsun fī Nisṭīn (sic cod. for Nisṭūr) innahū
ʿāša tisʿīna sanatan 356.8*
▬διὸκαὶτῶν παλαιῶν εἰπεῖν τινες προήχθησαν ὅτι …
Ps.-Arist. Mund. 6, 397b17 = wa-li-hāḏā mina l-qawli mā qāla unāsun mina l-
awwalīna anna … F 100a6; οἷάτινες ἤδη πεποιήκασι 1, 391a20 = ka-mā faʿala unā-
sun mina l-māḍīna F 86b16.
5. ἔνιοι (some people) : ὥσπερ ἔνιοι τῶν τεχνολογούντων τιθέασιν Arist. Rhet. I 2,
1356a11 = ka-mā ẓanna unāsun mina l-ḥuḏḏāqi bi-l-kalāmi 8.14; εἰδὲμή, ποιήσεις
ὅπερ ἔνιοι ποιοῦσι τῶν φιλοσοφούντων III 17, 1418a10 = wa-illā kāna ka-llaḏī qad
yafʿaluhū unāsun mina l-mutafalsifīna 217.6.
6. sem. amplif.; stands for the implied substantive in Greek adjectives used as
substantives; οἱπτερωτοί(winged, those with wings) = unāsun ḏawū aǧniḥatin
(people with wings) : τὸμέντοι φαντάζεσθαι ἐφ᾽ἡμῖν κεῖται … καὶτὰἀδύνατα
παντελῶς οἷον … πτερωτοὺς ὡς τοὺς Βορεάδας Them. In De an. 89.12 = fa-ammā l-
taḫayyulu fa-amruhū ilaynā ḥattā innā qad naqdiru an nataḫayyala … mā huwa
ġayru mumkinin ayḍan (or rather read aṣlan ayḍan?) miṯla … unāsin ḏawī aǧni-
ḥatin ka-mā *** (Lyons indicates a lacuna for the translation or transliteration of
Βορεάδας) 156.1*.
7. interpr.; σωματικός (corporeal, in reference to human bodies as opposed to
the incorporeality of god) = al-insi, in gen., following the modified noun in con-
struct state (of humans, human) : τῷδὲ(sc. θεῷτὸἄρχειν) ἄλυπον ἄπονόν τε καὶ
πάσης κεχωρισμένον σωματικῆς ἀσθενείας Ps.-Arist. Mund. 6, 400b11 = wa-huwa,
ǧalla wa-taʿālā, yabraʾu (yabraʾu EDD. : mbrāʾ ed.) mina l-hammi wa-l-ʿanāʾi (sc.
fī riʾāsatihī) lā tadḫuluhū mašaqqatun wa-lā yūsamu bi-šayʾin min ḍuʿfi (read
thus; cf. below nāsun 24 : ḍfh ed.) l-insi F 106a6*.

entries.lemma_raw: ناسnāsun (a contraction of unās, a pl. of ins; v. Lane 114 s.v. ins)
entries.body_text:
A. 1–6.
transl. substantives denoting human beings either singly or collec-
tively;
B. 7–12.
transl. pronouns and pronominal adjectives;
C. 13–15. sem.amplif.;standsforasubstantiveimpliedintheGreekbypronouns
or pronominal adjectives and by the nominal formation of the article
followed by adjectives and prepositional phrases;|
D. 16–20. sem. amplif.; stands for an implied substantive in the Greek which is
the subject or object of verbs and verbal nouns;
E. 21–25. added as generic substantive in various periphrastic, idiomatic, and
interpretive uses.
(NB: Because of the ubiquity of this Arabic word, the references in the following

baldatu l-insāni wa-baytuhū : ἐοίκασι γὰρ πατὴρ μὲν καὶμήτηρ τῇοἰκείᾳArtem.

1. ὁμέλλων (sc. χρόνος) (the future) : ὁγὰρ νῦν χρόνος συνάπτει πρός τε τὸν
παρεληλυθότα καὶτὸν μέλλοντα Arist. Cat. 6, 5a8 = fa-inna l-āna mina l-zamāni
yaṣilu mā bayna l-māḍī minhu wa-bayna l-mustaʾnafi 44.8 / fol. 165b17
▬
παι-
δάριον ὀφθὲν καιρὸν σημαίνει τὸν μέλλοντα Artem.Onirocr.178.15 = fa-inna l-insāna
iḏā raʾā … ṣabiyyan dalla ʿalā l-zamāni l-mustaʾnafi 322.10
▬
ἔστι γὰρ αὐτῆς
(sc. τῆς συμβουλίας) ἓν μὲν ἐκ τῶν παροιχομένων χρόνων λαμβανόμενον, ἓν δὲἐκ
τῶν μελλόντων, ἓν δὲἐκ τῶν ἐνεστώτων (μελλόντων and ἐνεστώτων transposed
Arab., Divisiones Marciani p. 36b16; cf. below Ps.-Arist. Div. 37a11–13) Ps.-Arist. Div.
36a17* = wa-l-raʾyu yanqasimu … ilā raʾyin yataʿallaqu bi-l-zamāni l-māḍī wa-
ilā raʾyin yataʿallaqu bi-l-zamāni l-ḥāḍiri wa-ilā raʾyin (read thus for al-raʾyi)
yataʿallaqu bi-l-zamāni l-mustaʾnafi version T 47.9*; τὰδὲἐκ τῶν μελλόντων (sc.
παραδείγματα) οἷον ταῖς ὑπονοίαις (τὰς ὑπονοίας as underst. Arab.) μὴἀδικεῖν τὰς
πρεσβείας (τοὺς πρέσβεις as underst. Arab.) 37a6 = wa-l-mutaʿallaqu bi-l-zamāni
l-mustaʾnafi ka-ẓanni l-ẓānni annahū lā yanbaġī an †yṣfy (? yuǧnā ?) ilā l-rusuli
version T 47.13*
▬καὶτοῦτο ἴδιον … τῆς ὑπὲρ τὴν φαντασίαν δυνάμεως τὸσυν-
αντιλαμβάνεσθαι καὶχρόνου ἤτοι παρελθόντος ἢμέλλοντος· ἡγὰρ αἴσθησις καὶἡ
φαντασία ἀναντίληπτοι … χρόνου καὶμάλιστα παρεληλυθότος ἢμέλλοντος Them. In
De an. 109.21–22 = wa-hāḏā amrun yaḫuṣṣu … l-quwwata llatī fawqa l-taḫayyuli
aʿnī annahā tudriku maʿa mā tudriku l-zamāna immā l-māḍiya wa-immā l-
mustaʾnafa, fa-inna l-ḥissa wa-l-taḫayyula ġayru mudrikayni … li-l-zamāni wa-
lā siyyamā l-zamāni l-māḍī awi l-mustaʾnafi 199.8–9.
2. ὕστερον (at a later time) = fī l-mustaʾnafi : περὶμὲν οὖν τῆς τοῦπαντὸς
φύσεως … ὕστερον ἐπισκεπτέον Arist. Cael. I 2, 268b12 = wa-sa-naḏkuru fī l-
mustaʾnafi ṭabīʿata l-kulli version B=C 129.6 Badawī.
3. transl. future derivations of εἶναι (to be)
3.1 ὁἐσόμενος (that will be, sc. χρόνος, i.e., the future) : τὸδὲνῦν ἐστιν συνέχεια
χρόνου, … συνέχει γὰρ τὸν χρόνον τὸν παρεληλυθότα καὶἐσόμενον Arist. Phys. IV 13,
222a11=wa-ammāl-ānufa-innahūwuṣlatul-zamāni…wa-ḏālikaannahūyaṣilu
l-zamāna l-sālifa bi-l-mustaʾnafi 462.5.

καὶτὸν χρόνον ὅταν ὡς περὶγενομένων | ἢἐσομένων διανοῆται Them. In De an.
109.19 = wa-l-ʿaqlu yaʿqilu maʿa mā yaʿqiluhu l-zamāna matā kāna mā yuʿqalu
fī ašyāʾa sālifatin aw mustaʾnafatin 199.6.
3.3 οὐκ ἐσόμενός ποτε = allaḏī fī l-mustaʾnafi laysa / allaḏī fī l-mustaʾnafi
ġayru mawǧūdin : περὶτοῦἀφθάρτου ... ἢτὸὄν μὲν δυνατὸν δὲμὴεἶναι, ἢκαὶ
οὐκ ἐσόμενόν ποτε, νῦν δ᾽ὄν Arist. Cael. I 11, 280b29 = wa-yuqālu ayḍan mā lā
yafsidu ʿalā waǧhin āḫara, iḏā kāna l-šayʾu aysa wa-lahū quwwatun an yakūna
laysa, awi l-šayʾu llaḏī fī l-mustaʾnafi laysa fa-ammā l-āna fa-huwa aysa version
B 240.11 Badawī; wa-yuqālu ġayru l-fāsidi ʿalā l-šayʾi l-mawǧūdi illā annahū fīhi
quwwatunʿalāanyaṣīraġayramawǧūdin,awʿalāl-šayʾillaḏīyakūnufīl-zamāni
l-ḥādiri … wa-fī l-mustaʾnafi ġayra mawǧūdin, wa-huwa li-aǧli ḏālika fāsidun
li-annahū yakūnu fī l-zamāni l-mustaʾnafi ġayra mawǧūdin version A 101b9.
11.
3.4 ἔσεσθαι
(a) abs. : οὐδεμία γὰρ δύναμις τοῦγεγονέναι ἐστίν, ἀλλὰτοῦεἶναι ἢ
ἔσεσθαι Arist.Cael.I12,283b14=li-annal-šayʾalayuqālufīhiinnahūbi-l-quwwati
bi-l-qiyāsi ilā fiʿlin qad maḍā, lākin bi-l-qiyāsi ilā mā yakūnu fī l-āni wa-fī l-
mustaʾnafi versionA121b13 (b) inhend.; mustaʾnafun ǧāʾin : οὐδεμία γὰρ δύναμις
τοῦγεγονέναι ἐστίν, ἀλλὰτοῦεἶναι ἢἔσεσθαι Arist. Cael. I 12, 283b14 = li-annahū lā

l-zamāni l-mustaʾnafi l-ǧāʾī version B 221.10 Badawī.

entries.lemma_raw: أهّلII. ahhala w. acc. p. or obj.
entries.body_text:
1. transl. ἀξιόω (basic meaning: to make a claim of worth) in various uses
1.1 ἀξιόω w. acc. p. or inf. and gen. obj. (to think s.o. worthy of) = ahhala w. acc.
p. (and li- obj.) : δοκεῖδὲ(δὲcodd., Arab. appar. : δὴBywater) μεγαλόψυχος εἶναι ὁ
μεγάλων αὑτὸν ἀξιῶν ἄξιος ὤν Arist.Eth.Nic.IV3,1123b2* = wa-qad yuẓannu anna
l-kabīra l-nafsi huwa llaḏī yuʾahhilu nafsahū li-l-umūri l-ʿaẓīmati wa-huwa li-
ḏālika ahlun 153.14 Badawī; ὁγὰρ μικρῶν ἄξιος καὶτούτων ἀξιῶν ἑαυτὸν σώφρων
1123b5 = wa-ammā man huwa ahlun li-umūrin yasīratin wa-huwa yuʾahhilu
nafsahū li-ḏālika fa-huwa ṣaḥīḥu l-raʾyi 153.17 Badawī; φαίνονται οἱμεγαλόψυ-
χοι περὶτιμὴν εἶναι· τιμῆς γὰρ μάλιστα οἱμεγάλοι (οἱμεγάλοι codd., Arab. : secl.
Bywater) ἀξιοῦσιν ἑαυτούς 1123b23* = wa-yatabayyanu min amri kabīrī l-anfusi …
annahum yaltamisūna l-karāmata, li-anna l-ʿuẓamāʾa bayna (bayna EDD. : dyn
ed. Badawī : min ed. Akasoy/Fidora) l-nāsi ḫāṣṣatan yuʾahhilūna anfusahum li-
l-karāmati 154.18* Badawī; sim. 1123b8–16 = 153.19–154.10 Badawī; δῆλον δὲκαὶἐπὶ
τῶν βασιλέων· οὐδὲγὰρ τούτοις ἀξιοῦσιν εἶναι φίλοι οἱπολὺκαταδεέστεροι VIII 7,
1159a1 = wa-ḏālika bayyinun fī l-mulūki ayḍan min aǧli anna llaḏīna dūnahum
lā yuʾahhilūna anfusahum an yakūnū aṣdiqāʾa li-ulāʾika 288.11 Badawī.
1.2 ἀξιόω w. acc. obj. (to require or claim that s.th. [be or be done]) = ahhala w.
acc. obj. or an : εἰοὖν μία μόνη (μόνη CΛ Arab. : om. codd. cett., ed.) πρότασις ἡ
ἓν καθ᾽ἑνὸς ἀξιοῦσα Arist. Soph. el. 6, 169a11* = fa-iḏan in kānati l-muqaddimatu
l-wāḥidatu faqaṭhiya llatī tuʾahhilu wāḥidan li-wāḥidin 841.8 / fol. 339b (naql
Yaḥyā b. ʿAdī); εἰδέτις ἀξιοῖδιαιρεῖν … ἄτοπον τὸἀξιοῦν … ὥστ᾽ἔοικεν ἀγνοεῖν ὁ
τοῦτο ἀξιῶν ὅτι … ἔτι τὸφάναι ἢἀποφάναι ἀξιοῦν οὐδεικνύντος ἐστίν ἀλλὰπεῖραν
λαμβάνοντος 10, 171a28, 30, 38; 11, 171b3 = wa-in ahhala insānun an yuqassima …
| fa-innahū šaniʿun an yuʾahhila; … wa-bi-l-ǧumlati fa-llaḏī yuʾahhilu hāḏā lā
yaʿlamu anna …; wa-ayḍan fa-an yuʾahhila an yaḍaʿa aw an yarfaʿa laysa huwa
li-llaḏī yubarhinu lākin li-llaḏī yaʾḫuḏu taǧribatan 871.13–14; 876.6, 11 / fol. 344b,
345b (naql Yaḥyā b. ʿAdī).
1.3 ἀξιόω w. acc. and inf. (to claim, maintain, lay down) = ahhala w. acc. obj. :
τὰγὰρ ἑνὶκαὶταὐτῷταὐτὰκαὶἀλλήλοις ἀξιοῦμεν εἶναι ταὐτάArist. Soph. el. 6,
168b32 = wa-ḏālika annā nuʾahhilu llawātī li-wāḥidin bi-ʿaynihī baʿḍahunna li-
baʿḍin hunna fīhinna 836.6 / fol. 338b (naql Yaḥyā b. ʿAdī); ὅτι γὰρ τὸγεγονὸς
ἔχει ἀρχήν, καὶτὸἔχον ἀρχὴν γεγονέναι ἀξιοῖ(sc. Μέλισσος) 168b38 = wa-ḏālika
anna min qibali anna llaḏī yatakawwanu lahū mabdaʾun yuʾahhilu (sc. Māl-
isus) llaḏī lahū mabdaʾun annahū yatakawwanu 836.11 / fol. 338b (naql Yaḥyā
b. ʿAdī).
2. ἀπονέμω w. dat. p. and acc. obj. (to assign, impart s.th. to s.o.) = ahhala w.
acc. p. and acc. obj. : ὅτι δὲτοὺς τὰτοιαῦθ᾽αὑτοῖς ἀπονέμοντας εἰώθασι λέγειν οἱ
πολλοὶφιλαύτους, οὐκ ἄδηλον Arist.Eth.Nic.IX8,1168b24 = wa-ammāanna akṯara
l-nāsi qadi ʿtāda an yusammiya llaḏīna yuʾahhilūna anfusahum hāḏihi l-ašyāʾa
muḥibbī ḏawātihim fa-bayyinun 322.11 Badawī.

paragraphs.header: ἀξιόω w. acc. p. or inf. and gen. obj. (to think s.o. worthy of) = ahhala w. acc. p. (and li- obj.)

belegstellen.greek: δοκεῖδὲ(δὲcodd., Arab. appar. : δὴBywater) μεγαλόψυχος εἶναι ὁ μεγάλων αὑτὸν ἀξιῶν ἄξιος ὤν
belegstellen.arabic: wa-qad yuẓannu anna l-kabīra l-nafsi huwa llaḏī yuʾahhilu nafsahū li-l-umūri l-ʿaẓīmati wa-huwa li-ḏālika ahlun 153.14 Badawī
belegstellen.author: Aristotle

belegstellen.greek: ὁγὰρ μικρῶν ἄξιος καὶτούτων ἀξιῶν ἑαυτὸν σώφρων 1123b5
belegstellen.arabic: wa-ammā man huwa ahlun li-umūrin yasīratin wa-huwa yuʾahhilu nafsahū li-ḏālika fa-huwa ṣaḥīḥu l-raʾyi 153.17 Badawī

belegstellen.greek: φαίνονται οἱμεγαλόψυ- χοι περὶτιμὴν εἶναι· τιμῆς γὰρ μάλιστα οἱμεγάλοι (οἱμεγάλοι codd., Arab. : secl. Bywater) ἀξιοῦσιν ἑαυτούς 1123b23*
belegstellen.arabic: wa-yatabayyanu min amri kabīrī l-anfusi … annahum yaltamisūna l-karāmata, li-anna l-ʿuẓamāʾa bayna (bayna EDD. : dyn ed. Badawī : min ed. Akasoy/Fidora) l-nāsi ḫāṣṣatan yuʾahhilūna anfusahum li-l-karāmati 154.18* Badawī; sim. 1123b8–16 = 153.19–154.10 Badawī
belegstellen.notes: Greek: (οἱμεγάλοι codd., Arab. : secl. Bywater) | Arabic: (bayna EDD. : dyn ed. Badawī : min ed. Akasoy/Fidora)

belegstellen.greek: δῆλον δὲκαὶἐπὶ τῶν βασιλέων· οὐδὲγὰρ τούτοις ἀξιοῦσιν εἶναι φίλοι οἱπολὺκαταδεέστεροι
belegstellen.arabic: wa-ḏālika bayyinun fī l-mulūki ayḍan min aǧli anna llaḏīna dūnahum lā yuʾahhilūna anfusahum an yakūnū aṣdiqāʾa li-ulāʾika 288.11 Badawī.
belegstellen.author: Aristotle

paragraphs.header: ἀξιόω w. acc. obj. (to require or claim that s.th. [be or be done]) = ahhala w. acc. obj. or an

belegstellen.greek: εἰοὖν μία μόνη (μόνη CΛ Arab. : om. codd. cett., ed.) πρότασις ἡ ἓν καθ᾽ἑνὸς ἀξιοῦσα
belegstellen.arabic: fa-iḏan in kānati l-muqaddimatu l-wāḥidatu faqaṭhiya llatī tuʾahhilu wāḥidan li-wāḥidin
belegstellen.author: Aristotle
belegstellen.notes: Greek: (μόνη CΛ Arab. : om. codd. cett., ed.) | Arabic: (naql Yaḥyā b. ʿAdī)

belegstellen.greek: εἰδέτις ἀξιοῖδιαιρεῖν … ἄτοπον τὸἀξιοῦν … ὥστ᾽ἔοικεν ἀγνοεῖν ὁ τοῦτο ἀξιῶν ὅτι … ἔτι τὸφάναι ἢἀποφάναι ἀξιοῦν οὐδεικνύντος ἐστίν ἀλλὰπεῖραν λαμβάνοντος 10, 171a28, 30, 38; 11, 171b3
belegstellen.arabic: wa-in ahhala insānun an yuqassima … | fa-innahū šaniʿun an yuʾahhila; … wa-bi-l-ǧumlati fa-llaḏī yuʾahhilu hāḏā lā yaʿlamu anna …; wa-ayḍan fa-an yuʾahhila an yaḍaʿa aw an yarfaʿa laysa huwa li-llaḏī yubarhinu lākin li-llaḏī yaʾḫuḏu taǧribatan 871.13–14; 876.6, 11 / fol. 344b, 345b (naql Yaḥyā b. ʿAdī).

paragraphs.header: ἀξιόω w. acc. and inf. (to claim, maintain, lay down) = ahhala w. acc. obj.

belegstellen.greek: τὰγὰρ ἑνὶκαὶταὐτῷταὐτὰκαὶἀλλήλοις ἀξιοῦμεν εἶναι ταὐτά
belegstellen.arabic: wa-ḏālika annā nuʾahhilu llawātī li-wāḥidin bi-ʿaynihī baʿḍahunna li-baʿḍin hunna fīhinna
belegstellen.author: Aristotle

belegstellen.greek: ὅτι γὰρ τὸγεγονὸς ἔχει ἀρχήν, καὶτὸἔχον ἀρχὴν γεγονέναι ἀξιοῖ(sc. Μέλισσος) 168b38
belegstellen.arabic: wa-ḏālika anna min qibali anna llaḏī yatakawwanu lahū mabdaʾun yuʾahhilu (sc. Māl-isus) llaḏī lahū mabdaʾun annahū yatakawwanu 836.11 / fol. 338b (naql Yaḥyā b. ʿAdī).
belegstellen.notes: Greek: (sc. Μέλισσος) | Arabic: (sc. Māl- isus) (naql Yaḥyā b. ʿAdī)

paragraphs.header: ἀπονέμω w. dat. p. and acc. obj. (to assign, impart s.th. to s.o.) = ahhala w. acc. p. and acc. obj.

belegstellen.greek: ὅτι δὲτοὺς τὰτοιαῦθ᾽αὑτοῖς ἀπονέμοντας εἰώθασι λέγειν οἱ πολλοὶφιλαύτους, οὐκ ἄδηλον
belegstellen.arabic: wa-ammāanna akṯara l-nāsi qadi ʿtāda an yusammiya llaḏīna yuʾahhilūna anfusahum hāḏihi l-ašyāʾa muḥibbī ḏawātihim fa-bayyinun 322.11 Badawī.
belegstellen.author: Aristotle

entries.body_text:
1. transl. ἄξιος (of worth) and its derivatives
1.1 ἄξιος (sc. ἐστί) w. gen. or inf. (to be worthy of, deserving) : οὐδὲτοῖς ἀρί-
στοις ἢσοφωτάτοις οἱμηδενὸς ἄξιοι (sc. ἀξιοῦσιν εἶναι φίλοι) Arist. Eth. Nic. VIII 7,
1159a3=wa-ka-ḏālikallaḏīnalāyastaʾhilūnašayʾanlāyakūnūnaaṣdiqāʾal-afāḍili
(al-afāḍili cod. : li-l-afāḍili edd.) wa-l-ḥukamāʾi ǧiddan 288.12* Badawī; ὅτε γὰρ
διδάξειεν(sc.ὁΠρωταγόρας)ἁδήποτε,τιμῆσαιτὸνμαθόνταἐκέλευενὅσουδοκεῖἄξια
ἐπίστασθαι IX1,1164a26 = fa-innahū (sc. Furūṭāġūras) kāna iḏā ʿallama šayʾan mā
kāna yaʾmuru l-mutaʿallima an yukrima ʿalā qadri mā yarā annahū yastaʾhilu
mā taʿallama 307.3 Badawī / 4.15 Arberry; δεῖδ᾽ἴσως οὐτοσούτου τιμᾶν ὅσου ἔχοντι
(ἔχοντι om. Arab. appar.) φαίνεται ἄξιον, ἀλλ᾽ὅσου πρὶν ἔχειν ἐτίμα IX 1, 1164b21* =
wa-yanbaġī allā takūna l-karāmatu ʿalā qadri ⟨mā⟩(mā suppl. Badawī : om.
cod., Arberry 6.5) yaẓharu annahū yastaʾhilu l-šayʾu bal ʿalā qadri mā fīhi mina
l-istiʾhāli 308.11 Badawī
▬ταῦτ᾽οὖν αὐτὰτῶν Στωϊκῶν ἐμέμψατο … ὁ… Ποσει-
δώνιος, ⟨ὃς⟩(suppl. Nauck) ἐν οἷς ἐπαίνων ἐστὶμεγίστων ἄξιος, ἐν τούτοις αὐτοῖς
ὑπὸτῶν ἄλλων οὐκ ἐπαινεῖται Στωϊκῶν Galen An. virt. 77.19 = fa-bi-hāḏihi l-ašyāʾi
| wabbaḫa l-riwāqiyyīna … Fūsīḏūniyūs allaḏī yaḏummūnahū wa-yaʿḏulūnahū
sāʾiru l-riwāqiyyīna bi-sababi l-ašyāʾi llatī bihā waḥdahā yastaʾhilu l-midḥata l-
kabīrata (read thus for al-kaṯīrata) 42.7.
1.2 sem.; etym.; ἀνάξιος (sc. ἐστί) w. gen. (to be unworthy of, undeserving) =
istaʾhala w. neg. : ἀφίστανται δὲκαὶτῶν πράξεων τῶν καλῶν καὶτῶν ἐπιτηδευ-
μάτων ὡς ἀνάξιοι ὄντες Arist. Eth. Nic. IV 3, 1125a26–27 = wa-ḏālika annahum
yahrubūna mina l-aʿmāli wa-l-ṣināʿāti l-ǧayyidati ʿalā annahum lā yastaʾhilū-
nahā 159.16 Badawī; διεξιοῦσι δὲπάντα φαίνοιτ᾽ἂν τὰπερὶτὰς πράξεις μικρὰκαὶ
ἀνάξια θεῶν X 8, 1178b18 = fa-in uḥṣiyat ǧamīʿu l-afʿāli fa-sa-yaẓharu annahā ṣaġī-
ratun lā tastaʾhilu an tuqāla (sic Badawī, Ullmann NE I, 55 : yastaʾhilu an yuqāla
Axelroth) ʿalā l-ālihati 354.4 Badawī / 71.2* Axelroth
▬
καὶἐὰν φιλότιμοι ***
(lac.ind.EDD.;cf.Lyonsp.325)ὦσινὧνἕτεροιἀνάξιοιὄντεςτυγχάνουσιν Arist.Rhet.
II 9, 1387b10* = ṯumma in kānū muḥibbīna li-l-karāmati wa-sāʾiri l-umūri llatī
yaẓfaru bihā āḫarūna wa-hum lā yastaʾhilūna 115.15.
2. sem.; etym.; ὁἐπιεικέστατος (most fitting with regard to goodness) = mani
staʾhala mina l-afāḍili : ὀλίγοι δὴἄρχουσι καὶμοχθηροὶἀντὶτῶν ἐπιεικεστάτων
Arist. Eth. Nic. VIII 10, 1160b16 = wa-yakūnu l-ruʾasāʾu qalīlīna wa-ḏawī radāʾatin
badala man yastaʾhilu ḏālika mina l-afāḍili 294.12 Badawī.
3. morph.; renders the verbal adj. suffix -τέος indicating necessity : φατέος
(that must be said) = yastaʾhilu an yusammā (that merits to be called) : τίνα
τούτων (sc. τῶν ἐπιστημῶν) φατέον εἶναι τὴν ζητουμένην ἢτίνα μάλιστα τοῦπρά-
γματος (τοῦζητουμένου add. Π Alc, Jaeger : om.Ab Arab.) ἐπιστήμονα τῶν ἐχόντων
αὐτάς Arist. Metaph. B 2, 996b3–4* = fa-yanbaġī lanā an naṭluba ayya ʿilmin min
hāḏihīyastaʾhiluanyusammāḥikmatanwa-ayyaʿāliminbi-šayʾinminal-ʿulūmi
yastaʾhilu an yusammā ḥakīman 184.11–12.

entries.body_text:
1. ἀξία (worth) : τὴν ἀξίαν δὲποτέρου τάξαι ἐστί, τοῦπροϊεμένου ἢτοῦπρολαβόν-
τος; Arist. Eth. Nic. IX 1, 1164a22 = wa-li-ayyihimā yanbaġī an takūna martabatu
l-istiʾhāli, li-llaḏī aʿṭā ⟨am li-llaḏī aḫaḏa⟩(lac. ind. and suppl. in note 15 Arberry)
306.17* Badawī / 4.13 Arberry; μὴτοιαύτης δ᾽οὔσης τῆς δόσεως, ἀλλ᾽ἐπί| τινι
μάλιστα μὲν ἴσως δεῖ(thus punctuated Arab.) τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν γίνεσθαι δοκοῦσαν
ἀμφοῖν κατ᾽ἀξίαν εἶναι 1164b8 = fa-innahū wa-in kānati l-ʿaṭiyyatu laysat miṯla
hāḏihī wa-lākin yanbaġī fī baʿḍi l-ašyāʾi an takūna l-mukāfaʾatu akṯara ḏālika
bi-l-musāwāti ʿalā qadri mā yarā kilāhumā annahā ʿalā l-istiʾhāli 308.1 Badawī /
5.9 Arberry; ὅσον γὰρ οὗτος ὠφελήθη ... τοσοῦτον ἀντιλαβὼν ἕξει τὴν παρὰτούτου
ἀξίαν 1164b12 = fa-innahū ʿalā qadri mā ntafaʿa hāḏā … ʿalā qadri ḏālika yaʾḫuḏu
minhu mukāfaʾatan mina l-istiʾhāli (yaʾḫuḏu minhu mukāfaʾatan corr.Ullmann,
NE II,235 : mukāfaʾa yaʾḫuḏu minhu ʿalā qadri ḏālika cod., ed.) 308.4* Badawī /
5.12*Arberry;VIII 12, 1160b33, 36 = 295.8, 10 Badawī (cf.WGAÜ Suppl. I, 134.14); IX1,
1164b4 = 307.14 Badawī; 1164b21 = 308.12 Badawī (v. above, istaʾhala 1.1); cf. VIII 13,
1162b24* = 301.14 Badawī (where the translator presumably read ἀξίαν instead of
αὐτὴν); etc.
2. ἀξίωμα (claim, request) : εἴτε τοίνυν τῇἀληθείᾳοὕτως ἔχει, οὐκ ἴσον τὸἀξί-
ωμα Arist. Eth. Nic. IX2, 1165a11 = fa-in kāna hāḏā hākaḏā bi-l-ḥaqīqati lā yakūnu
l-istiʾhālu yusāwī 309.21 Badawī.
3. ἐπιεικής (good, fair)
(a) ḏū l-istiʾhāli : εἶναι τὸαἱρετὸν τὸἐπιεικὲς καὶτὸ
μάλιστα κράτιστον (sc. μηνύει[ν] as underst. Arab.) Arist. Eth. Nic. X 2, 1172b11 = fa-
innahū yuʿallimu l-muḫtāra ḏū (sic ed. for ḏā) l-istiʾhāli wa-l-qawiyya ǧiddan
336.1ⓧBadawī / 37.5ⓧAxelroth; διαφερουσῶν δὲτῶν ἐνεργειῶν ἐπιεικεῖ(ἐπι-
εικεῖArab. : ἐπιεικείᾳcodd.) καὶφαυλότητι … ὁμοίως ἔχουσι καὶαἱἡδοναίX 5,
1175b24* = fa-lammā kānat taḫtalifu l-afʿālu bi-ḏī l-istiʾhāli wa-l-radāʾati … ṣārati
l-laḏḏātu ayḍan mutašābihatan 345.9 Badawī / 55.4 Axelroth; ἴσοι γὰρ οἱπολῖται
βούλονται καὶἐπιεικεῖς εἶναιVIII11,1161a29 = min aǧli annahū yurādu an yakūna l-
madaniyyūnamutasāwīnaḏawīl-istiʾhāli 297.1Badawī;VIII12,1162a11,26=299.6,
18 Badawī; X 5, 1175b28 = 345.11 Badawī / 55.7 Axelroth (v. above muʾḏin 7); etc.
(b) in hend.; ḏū murūʾatin wa-stiʾhālin : πολλοὶγάρ εἰσιν εὖνοι οἷς οὐχ ἑωράκα-
σιν, ὑπολαμβάνουσι δὲἐπιεικεῖς εἶναι ἢχρησίμους Arist. Eth. Nic. VIII 2, 1155b35 =
iḏannahū yulfā kaṯīrun mimman yanṣaḥu man lam yara aw (read thus for yara
wa- Badawī; cf. Ullmann NE II, 214) yaẓunnu bihim annahum ḏawū rawiyyatin
(siccod. : murūʾatin ed.Badawī) wa-stiʾhālin lā (lā cod. : wa-Badawī) manfaʿatin
276.17*Badawī.
4. ὀφείλημα (debt, just claim) : δῆλον δ᾽ἐν ταύτῃ(sc. τῇφιλίᾳ) τὸὀφείλημα
κοὐκ ἀμφίλογον Arist. Eth. Nic. VIII 13, 1162b28 = wa-l-istiʾhālu fī hāḏihī (sc. al-
maḥabbati) bayyinun lā šakka fīhi 301.17 Badawī. |

τὰἁπαλὰφύλλα τῆς … μυρσίνης ἀγρίας ἢἡμέρου κόπτε πιέζων Diosc. Mat. med. I,
40.1 = duhn al-āsi … ṣifatuhū: taʾḫuḏu min waraqi l-āsi barriyyan kāna aw bus-
tāniyyan mā kāna ṭariyyan wa-duqqahū wa-ʿṣirhu Ibn al-Bayṭār Ǧāmiʿ II, 99.22;
καὶτρίχας ῥεούσας μετὰλαδάνου καὶοἴνου καὶμυρσινίνου καταχριομένη ῥώννυσι (sc.
ἡσμύρνα) I, 59.3 = wa-iḏā ḫuliṭa (ḫuliṭa, sc. al-murru, Ibn al-Bayṭār and Ḥāwī
21, 502.6 : | perhaps luṭiḫa is to be read) bi-l-lāḏani wa-l-ḫamri wa-duhni l-āsi
amsaka l-šaʿra l-mutasāqiṭa Ibn al-Bayṭār Ǧāmiʿ IV, 146.9.
3. μύρσινος adj., sc. κηρωτή([cerate] liquified with myrtle oil) = (šamʿun)
ḫuliṭa / muḏābun bi-duhni l-āsi : οἱμὲν γὰρ χρίσματα μίσγουσιν αὐτῷ(sc. τῷ
ὀποβάλσαμῳ) ὡς … μέλι, κηρωτὴν μυρσίνην ἢκυπρίνην Diosc. Mat. med. I, 24.18 =
li-anna mina l-nāsi man yaḫliṭu bihī (sc. bi-duhni l-balsāni) baʿḍa l-adhāni …
wa-baʿḍu l-nāsi yaḫliṭu bihī ʿasalan aw šamʿan qad ḫuliṭa bi-duhni l-āsi aw
bi-duhni l-ḥinnāʾi Ibn al-Bayṭār Ǧāmiʿ I, 108.5; ἀναλημφθεὶς δὲκηρωτῇμυρσίνῃ
ἀπουλοῖ(sc. ὁφλοιὸς τῆς πίτυος) τὰ… ἕλκη I, 65.9 = wa-iḏā stuʿmila (sc. qišru l-
tannūbi)bi-šamʿinmuḏābinbi-duhnil-āsiadmalal-qurūḥa Ibnal-BayṭārǦāmiʿ
III, 88.28.
4. μυρτίτης (sc. οἶνος) ([wine] flavoured with myrtle) = šarābu l-āsi : μυρτίτην
καὶπάντα τὸν ἐσκευασμένον οἶνον πίνειν πλουσίοις … ἀγαθόν Artem. Onirocr. 72.3 =
fa-ammā in raʾā l-insānu ka-annahū yašrabu … šarāba l-āsi wa-kulla šarābin
yuhayyaʾu min miṯli ḏālika fa-innahū li-l-aġniyāʾi ḫayrun 132.14.
5. μυρσινίτης (sc. οἶνος, = μυρτίτης) ([wine] flavoured with myrtle) = šarābu
l-āsi : μυρσινίτης δὲσκευάζεται οὕτω· δεῖλαβόντας τῶν μελαίνων μυρσινῶν τοὺς
ἀκρεμόνας καὶτὰφύλλα σὺν τοῖς μύρτοις κόπτειν Diosc. Mat. med. III, 22.18 =
ṣanʿatu šarābi l-āsi : yuʾḫaḏu aṭrāfu l-āsi l-aswadi wa-waraquhū maʿa ḥabbihī
fa-yudaqqu Ibn al-Bayṭār Ǧāmiʿ I, 29.25.
6. sem.; etym.; μυρσινοειδής (myrtle-like) = šabīhun bi-l-āsi : κληματίς· … οἱδὲ
μυρσινοειδές … καλοῦσι Diosc. Mat. med. II, 173.9 = mina l-nāsi man yusammīhi
(sc. al-quḍḍāba l-miṣriyya) mursinuwaydās wa-maʿnāhu l-šabīhu bi-l-āsi Ibnal-
Bayṭār Ǧāmiʿ IV, 23.25.
7. periphr.; μυρτίδανον (warty excrescence on the stem of the myrtle) = bunku
l-āsi : τὸδὲμυρτίδανον λεγόμενον ἐπίφυσίς ἐστιν … οἱονεὶχεῖρες περὶτὸτῆς μυρσί-
νης πρέμνον Diosc. Mat. med. I, 106.14 = bunku l-āsi qad yakūnu ʿalā sāqi šaǧari
l-āsi … fī mušābahati l-kaffi fī šaklihī Ḥāwī 20, 16.7 ( for Ibn al-Bayṭār’s version of
this sentence v. above āsun 1). |

arṭālin wa-ṯamāniyata (sic ed. for ṯamāniya) awāqin wa-mina l-zayti tisʿata
arṭālin wa-ḫamsata (sic ed. for ḫamsa) awāqin wa-duqqa qišra l-kufarrā Ibn al-

Ǧāmiʿ III, 59.3

entries.body_text:
1. morph.; renders the suffix -ειος, expressing affiliation, when used as a patro-
nymic to indicate descent, in οἱΠυθαγόρειοι (the Pythagoreans) = ālu Fūṯāġūras :
καὶπάντες ὡς ἀρχήν τινα τιθέασι τῶν ὄντων (sc. τὸἄπειρον), … ὥσπερ οἱΠυθαγόρειοι
Arist. Phys. III 4, 203a4 = wa-kulluhum ǧaʿalahū (sc. lā-nihāyata) ka-l-mabdaʾi li-
l-mawǧūdāti miṯla āli Fūṯāġūras 203.3; ὥστε ἀτόπως ἂν ἀποφαίνοιντο οἱλέγοντες
οὕτως ὥσπερ οἱΠυθαγόρειοίφασιν III 5, 204a33 = fa-qad ẓaharat šanāʿatu hāḏā
l-qawli iḏkāna mušākilan li-mā yaqūluhū ālu Fūṯāġūras 224.6; IV 6, 213b23 =
342.5.

1. transl. ὄργανον (instrument, organ) and its derivatives and compounds
1.1 ὄργανον (instrument, organ) (a) abs. : ἄλογον τὸμηθὲν | ὄργανον αὐτοῖς
(sc. τοῖς ἄστροις) ἀποδοῦναι τὴν φύσιν πρὸς τὴν κίνησιν Arist. Cael. II 8, 290a30 =
innahū ḫāriǧun mina l-qiyāsi an takūna l-ṭabīʿatu ǧaʿalati l-nuǧūma muta-
ḥarrikatan wa-lam tuhayyiʾ lahā ālata l-ḥarakati version B 261.11 = ǧaʿalat li-
l-kawākibi ḥarakatan wa-lam tuʿidda lahā ālatan li-l-taḥrīki version A 88a3;
ἥκιστα δὲκινητικὸν ἡσφαῖρα διὰτὸμηδὲν ἔχειν ὄργανον πρὸς τὴν κίνησιν II 10,
291b16 = wa-l-falaku laysa bi-mutaḥarrikin li-annahū laysa lahū šayʾun min ālati
l-ḥarakati li-yataḥarraka bihā version B 269.2
▬
Arist. De an. II 1, 412b1 = 30.5
(v. above anniyyatun 9); III 10, 433b19 = 83.17; etc.
▬

▬διὸτὰμὲν
ὅλως ἀκίνητα τῶν ζώντων δι᾽ἔνδειαν τοῦὀργάνου (τοῦὀργάνου codd. cett., Arab. :

τες τὸἀληλεσμένον δι᾽ὀργάνου ἐκθλίβουσιν (sc. οἱΑἰγύπτιοι) Diosc. Mat. med.

μεν (sc. τοὺς περισσούς) ὡς δι᾽ὀργάνου ἢκοσκίνου τινός Nicom. Arithm. 29.20 =

τελεῖται τοῦσώματος IV 3, 19.26 = lā tafʿalu afāʿīlahā bi-ālāti l-badani 40.8; τάτε
δι᾽ὀργάνων σωματικῶν ἔργα (sc. τῆς ψυχῆς) IV 3, 20.7 = aʿmālu l-nafsi l-kāʾinatu
bi-l-ālāti l-ǧusdāniyyati 41.20
▬
τὸκάλλος διαιρεῖται εἰς τρία· … ἄλλο δὲχρηστι-
κόν, οἷον ὄργανον καὶοἰκία Ps.-Arist. Div. 14a6 = li-l-ǧamāli anwāʿun ṯalāṯatun …
wa-minhu l-istiʿmālu ka-l-ālati (ka-l-ālati EDD. : ka-l-āniyati ed.) wa-l-buyūti
version Q 36.24*
▬
Ps.-Arist. Mund. 6, 398b15 = F 102a3
▬
Ps.-Plut. Placita
390a12 = 51.14; 394a8, 18 = 53.6, 13; etc.
▬εἰγὰρ οἵα τε (sc. ἡψυχὴ) καὶχωρὶς τῶν
ὀργάνων αἰσθάνεσθαι, διὰτίοὐχὶκαὶαὐτῶν αἰσθάνεται τῶν ὀργάνων Them. In De

(b) in hend.; ālatun wa-adātun : τὰδὲἐς χειρουρ-

l-marīḍu wa-l-muʿāliǧu wa-ḫadamuhū wa-ālātuhū wa-adawātuhū wa-l-ḍawʾu
1.9.
1.2 τὸὀργανικόν subst. (that which serves as instrument or organ) : τὸοὗ
ἕνεκα, λέγω δ᾽οἷον τότε γεννητικὸν καὶτὸὀργανικὸν τῷγεννωμένῳ(thus punc-
tuated Arab.) Arist. Gener. anim. II 6, 742a24 = fa-ammā llaḏī min aǧlihī fa-
huwa l-muwallidu wa-ālatu l-ašyāʾi llatī tatawalladu wa-tukawwanu 78.9
▬

ammā l-ālatu llatī waḍaʿnāhā ʿalā l-qāʾimi l-murabbaʿi fa-hiya min šabahin
157.7. |

κἂν τὰφυτὰκινητικὰἦν, κἂν εἶχέτι μόριον ὀργανικὸν πρὸς τὴν κίνησιν ταύτην Arist.
De an. III 9, 432b18 = wa-law anna l-quwwata l-ġāḏiyata kānat ʿillata ḥarakati
l-intiqāli la-kānati l-šaǧaru muntaqilatan ⟨wa-⟩(suppl. Badawī) la-kāna lahā
ʿuḍwun ka-ālatin talīqu bi-hāḏihi l-ḥarakati 81.1
(b) allaḏī huwa ālatun/ālatu
l-ǧasadi : ἅμα δὲτὰὁμοιομερῆ(sc. μόρια) γίγνεται καὶτὰὀργανικάArist. Gener.
anim. II 1, 734b28 = wa-l-aʿḍāʾu llatī aǧzāʾuhā tušbihu baʿḍuhā baʿḍan takūnu
maʿan wa-l-aʿḍāʾu llatī hiya ālatu l-ǧasadi 58.19–20; ὥστε τῶν μορίων τῶν ὀργα-
νικῶν ὅσα μέν ἐστι γεννητικὰτὴν φύσιν δεῖπρότερον (δεῖπρότερον PΓ2, Arab. :
ἀεὶπρότερον δεῖcodd. cett., ed.) ὑπάρχειν αὐτάII 6, 742b4* = fa-ammā mina l-

▬συν-
εστήκασι τὰὀργανικὰτῶν μορίων Arist. Part. anim. II 1, 646b26 = ṣāra tarkību
l-aʿḍāʾi llatī hiya ālatun li-kulli l-ǧasadi 25.1; ἐκ τούτων γὰρ συνέστηκεν ἕκαστον
τῶν ὀργανικῶν μερῶν II 2, 647b23 = fa-inna kulla wāḥidin mina l-aʿḍāʾi llatī hiya

(c) allaḏī miṯlu ālatin : τὸὅλον καὶτὸτέλος,
τρίτον δὲ(καὶτελευταῖον after δὲcodd. : om. Arab.) τὰὀργανικὰτούτοις μέρη Arist.

l-aʿḍāʾu llatī hiya miṯlu ālatin 78.19; τὰδὲκινητικὰ(sc. τῶν μορίων) πρὸς τὰὀργα-
νικὰδιελεῖν οὐῥᾴδιον II 6, 742b10 = wa-laysa tafṣīlu l-aʿḍāʾi l-muḥarrikati mina

(d)
šayʾun mina l-ālāti : ἄλλο δ᾽οὐδὲν ἔχει (sc. τὸτήθυον) μόριον οὔτε ὀργανικὸν οὔτε

1.7 sem.; etym.; ὀργανοποιία (instrument-making)
(a) tahyiʾatu l-ālāti : ἐπὶ
δὲτῶν θέσεων καὶτάξεων … ταῖς ἁπλουστέραις τῶν ἀγωγῶν καταχρώμενοι πρὸς
τὸεὐμεθόδευτον τῆς ὀργανοποιίας Ptol. Hypoth. 72.22 = wa-nastaʿmilu fī waḍʿi l-
aflāki … wa-tartībihā l-maḏhaba (al-maḏhaba EDD. : li-l-maḏhabi codd.) llaḏī

70.14 = li-yakūna taṣawwuruhā fī awhāminā wa-awhāmi man arāda an yaʿmala
lahā l-ālāti sahlan 13.11 / fol. 81b11.
2. σκεῦος (implements, fittings) (a) abs. : σπλὴν δὲἡδονὰς καὶγέλωτα καὶ
τὰἔπιπλα τῶν σκευῶν (sc. σημαίνει) Artem. Onirocr. 51.6 = wa-ammā l-ṭiḥālu
fa-yadullu ʿalā l-laḏḏati wa-l-ḍaḥki wa-ʿalā l-ālāti l-mustaʿmalati 96.10 (where
ālatun transl. σκεῦος and mustaʿmalatun transl. ἔπιπλα, i.e., lighter and movable
furnishings, as opposed to the heavier kind implied by σκεύη; v. LSJ s.v. ἔπιπλα);
μηδὲὑπὲρ τὴν ἀξίαν (sc. ἀγαθὸς ὁχρυσός), ὡς τοῖς πένησιν οἱστέφανοι ⟨καὶἡμεγάλη
σκευὴ⟩(add. Arab. : om. LV, ed.) καὶτὰμεγάλα σκεύη καὶτὰπολλὰνομίσματα
107.8* = aw (an) yakūna (sc. ṣāḥibu l-ruʾyā) mimmā lā yastaḥiqqu miṯla tilka
l-ruʾyā, aʿnī an yakūna faqīran fa-yarā ka-annahū tuwwiǧa bi-tāǧin aw annahū
fī hayʾatin nabīlatin ǧiddan wa-lahu l-ālātu l-ʿaẓīmatu wa-l-mālu l-kaṯīru 197.14
(where the original Greek appears to have been, οἱστέφανοι καὶἡμεγάλη σκευὴ
καὶτὰπολλὰνομίσματα; in the Greek tradition prior to the | age represented by
the two extant MSS, σκευή[ fashionable attire] was misread as σκεύη [imple-
ments] and accordingly ἡμεγάλη [or μεγίστη?] was changed to τὰμεγάλα to
agree with the pl. σκεύη; the Arabic translation drew upon a Greek MS that con-
tained both the original reading and the corruption that was inserted into the
text, whereas the two extant Greek MSS retained only the corrupt form; for the
translation of μέγιστος as nabīl and σκευήas hayʾa see Schmitt p. 117, 361b)
(b)
in hend.; ināʾun wa-ālatun : ἡγεῖσθαι χρὴτοὺς … κυνόδοντας τὰμὴπολλῆς ἄξια
τιμῆς, τοὺς δὲτομεῖς τὰἔπιπλα τῶν σκευῶν (sc. σημαίνειν) Artem. Onirocr. 38.10 =
fa-qad yanbaġī an yuʿlama anna … l-anyāba tadullu ʿalā ⟨***⟩(lac. ind. EDD.)
l-āniyati wa-l-ālāti l-mustaʿmalati 72.1–2* (where the hend. transl. σκεύη and
mustaʿmala transl. ἔπιπλα; v. above (a)).

amplif.; ālatu l-ṣunnāʿi : ὅσα δὲτῶν ἐργαλείων ἑνοῖἢσυνδεῖ, ταῦτα ὠφελείας …
προαγορεύει Artem. Onirocr. 59.26 = wa-ammā ālātu l-ṣunnāʿi llatī yurbaṭu bihā
fa-innahā tadullu ʿalā manāfiʿa 110.12.
4. τὰἄρμενα (utensils) : ἐν ὀλίγῃσι γὰρ οἰκίῃσι παρεσκεύασται τὰἄρμενα καὶοἱ

tāǧu ilayhā fī stiʿmālihī (sc. al-ḥammāmi) wa-l-ḫadama llaḏīna yaḫdumūna ʿalā

1. transl. ἀρχή(beginning) and its derivatives and compounds

9. sem. amplif.; in comparisons, it supplies explicitly the implied object of com-
parison

tadullu ʿalā maḍārra hiya šarrun mina l-ūlā 216.9.
9.2 sem. amplif.; added after an adv. of comparison : ἰσάκις ([multiplied] by
what is equal to [the former]) = ḍarbun fīmā yusāwī l-awwala : ὅταν τοίνυν δύο

l-awwalayni 111.20*–112.2; sim. 119.6 = 93.4; 135.14 = 104.13; etc.

entries.body_text:
junctive expressions
1. ὁμὲν … ὁδέ(the one … the other)
(a) al-awwalu … al-ṯānī : ἡτῶν κοιλιῶν
ἑτέρα πρὸς ἑτέρας δεχομένη τὴν τροφήν, ἡμὲν ἀκατέργαστον, ἡδὲκατειργασμένην
μᾶλλον, ἡδὲπάμπαν Arist. Part. anim. III 14, 674b11–12 = qabilahū (sc. al-ṭaʿāma)
baṭnun baʿda baṭnin … fa-l-baṭnu l-awwalu yaqbalu l-ṭaʿāma ġayra maṭḥūnin
wa-l-baṭnu l-ṯānī yaqbaluhū maṭḥūnan wa-l-baṭnu l-ṯāliṯu yaqbaluhū wa-ṭab-
ḫuhū aǧwadu 94.14
▬καὶΔημόκριτος τὸπλῆρες καὶκενόν (sc. ἀρχὰς ποιεῖ), ὧν
τὸμὲν ὡς ὂν τὸδὲὡς οὐκ ὂν εἶναίφησιν Arist. Phys. I 5, 188a23 = wa-Dīmuqrīṭus
fī qawlihī bi-l-ḫalāʾi wa-l-malāʾi ammā l-awwalu fa-ʿalā annahū mawǧūdun wa-
ammā l-ṯānī fa-ʿalā annahū laysa bi-mawǧūdin 43.9–10; τούτων δὲτὸμὲν ὅ(sc.
κινεῖται), τὸδ᾽εἰς ὅ, τὸδ᾽ἐξ οὗV 1, 224b3 = wa-l-awwalu min hāḏihī huwa l-
mutaḥarrikuwa-l-ṯānīhuwallaḏīilayhil-ḥarakatuwa-l-ṯāliṯuhuwallaḏīminhu
l-ḥarakatu 493.1
▬ἀγαθὸν δὲκαὶἄπαιδι καὶτῷσυγγενῆἀπόδημον ἔχοντι· ὁμὲν
γὰρ τέκνον γενόμενον ὁδὲσυγγενῆἀνακομισθέντα … ὄψονται Artem. Onirocr. 42.8–
9 = wa-hāḏihi l-ruʾyā maḥmūdatun ayḍan li-man ⟨lā⟩(suppl. Fahd) yakūnu
lahū awlādun wa-li-man kāna min ǧinsihī raǧulun fī bilādi ġurbatin (ġurbatin
cod., v. Rosenthal 141b : al-|ġurbati ed.) wa-ḏālika anna l-awwala minhā (sic cod.
for minh⟨um⟩ā, suppl. Fahd) tadullu ʿalā annahū yūladu lahū waladun wa-l-
ṯāniya tadullu fīhi ʿalā anna qarābatahū (sic cod. for ḏā qarābatihī, v. Lane VII,
2508a) yarǧiʿu min safarihī fa-yarāhu 79.11–12*ⓧ; εἰδέτις Ἑλληνικὰμανθάνοι
γράμματα Ῥωμαῖος ὢν ἢῬωμαϊκὰἝλλην, ὁμὲν εἰς Ἑλληνικὰς διατριβὰς ὁδὲεἰς
Ῥωμαϊκὰς ἀφίξεται 60.15–16 = fa-in kāna ṣāḥibu l-ruʾyā rūmiyyan wa-raʾā ka-
annahū yataʿallamu kitābata l-yūnāniyyīna aw kāna yūnāniyyan wa-raʾā ka-
annahū yataʿallamu kitābata l-rūmi fa-inna l-awwala min hāḏayni yaṣīru ilā
an yaʾwiya fīmā bayna l-yūnāniyyīna ⟨wa-l-ṯāniya yaṣīru ilā an yaʾwiya fīmā
bayna l-rūmi⟩(suppl. EDD. : om. cod. ed.) 111.15*
▬
τὸδιαμένειν καὶμηδὲν ἐνδι-
δόναι τὸσῶμα, ἢκαὶσυντήκεσθαι μᾶλλον τοῦκατὰλόγον, μοχθηρόν· τὸμὲν γὰρ
μῆκος νούσου σημαίνει, τὸδέ, ἀσθένειαν Hippocr. Aph. II 28 = fa-in yabqa (read
thus) badanuhū ʿalā ḥālihī wa-lā yanquṣu šayʾan aw yaḏūbu akṯara mimmā
yanbaġī fa-ḏālika radīʾun li-anna l-awwala yunḏiru bi-ṭūlin mina l-maraḍi wa-
l-ṯāniya yadullu ʿalā ḍuʿfin mina l-quwwati 14.10–11
(b) al-awwalu … al-āḫaru :
χιμαίρεια δὲ(sc. κρέα) τοῖς ἐν χειμῶνι διάγουσιν ἀγαθὰτετήρηται, τοῖς δὲἄλλοις
ἀκερδῆ· ὧν μὲν γὰρ τὰδεινὰδιαλύει … οἷς δὲδιὰτὸὀστῶδες μικρὰς τὰς ἐργασίας
παρέχει Artem. Onirocr. 76.8–10 = fa-ammā laḥmu l-māʿizi fa-innahū ǧayyidun
li-man kāna fī bilādin bāridatin … fa-ammā li-sāʾiri l-nāsi fa-innahū radīʾun wa-
ḏālika annahū yuḥallilu l-šiddata ʿan ulāʾika l-awwalīna … wa-huwa radīʾun li-
l-āḫarīna li-annahū laḥmun ġalīẓun fa-huwa yadullu ʿalā qillati l-ʿamali lahum
140.8–9.
2. εἷς … ἄλλος / ἕτερος (the one … the other) = awwaluhā … al-ṯānī : τῆς φιλαν-
θρωπίας ἐστὶν εἴδη τρία· ἓν μὲν διὰτῆς προσηγορίας γινόμενον, … ἄλλο εἶδος, ὅταν
τις βοηθητικὸς ᾖπαντὶτῷἀτυχοῦντι … Ps.-Arist. Div. 26a11–16 = li-l-mawadd⟨at⟩i
(suppl. EDD.) ṯalāṯatu anwāʿin awwaluhā basṭu l-raǧuli kaffahū li-man yalqāhu
wa-l-ṯānīmaʿūnatuḏīl-ḥāǧativersionQ34.23*;εὐνομίαδιαιρεῖταιεἰςτρία·ἓνμὲν…
ἕτερον δέ… 32a16–33a2 = wa-l-tadbīru bi-ḥasabi l-sunnati yanqasimu ilā ṯalāṯati
aqsāmini l-awwalu … wa-l-ṯānī … version T 48.8–11; 11a3–6 = version T 53.8–10;
etc.
3. οὗτος … ἐκεῖνος (the former … the latter) = al-awwalu … al-ṯānī : Nicom.
Arithm. 29.15–16 = 31.14 (v. above aḥadun 3.6). |

5. |

εἴρηται (it has been said) = ḏakarnā awwalan (we mentioned before) : ἤτοι οὐδὲ

entries.body_text:
1. transl. ἀρχή(beginning) alone and in compounds
1.1 ἀρχή(beginning; first principle) : ἔστι γὰρ (sc. ἡψυχὴ) οἷον ἀρχὴτῶν ζῴων
Arist. De an. I 1, 402a6 = wa-ḏālika annahā (sc. al-nafsa) ka-awwaliyyatin li-
l-ḥayawāni 3.12; καὶἩράκλειτος δὲτὴν ἀρχὴν εἶναίφησι ψυχήν I 2, 405a25 (=
Heracleitus fr. A15, Diels / Kranz I, 147.24) = wa-Īrāqilīṭus zaʿama ayḍan anna
l-awwaliyyata nafsun 11.12; I 5, 411b28 = 28.2; etc.
▬οἷον ὁΜελίσσου λόγος ὅτι
ἄπειρον τὸἅπαν, λαβὼν τὸμὲν ἅπαν ἀγένητον …, τὸδὲγενόμενον ἐξ ἀρχῆς γενέ-
σθαι· εἰμὴοὖν γέγονεν, ἀρχὴν οὐκ ἔχειν τὸπᾶν, ὥστ᾽ἄπειρον· οὐκ ἀνάγκη δὲ|
τοῦτο συμβαίνειν, οὐγὰρ εἰτὸγενόμενον ἅπαν ἀρχὴν ἔχει, καὶεἴτι ἀρχὴν ἔχει, γέγο-
νεν Arist. Soph. el. 5, 167b15–18 (= Melissos fr. A 10, Diels / Kranz I, 267.17ff.) =
ka-qawli Mālisus al-ḥakīmi inna l-kulla lā nihāyata lahū wa-ḏālika annahū
ǧaʿala muqaddimatahū anna l-kulla min šayʾin laysa bi-mukawwanin … wa-
anna l-kāʾina innamā kāna bi-awwaliyyatin fa-in kāna l-kullu min šayʾin laysa
bi-ḥādiṯin fa-laysa li-l-kulli awwaliyyatun; min aǧli ḏālika waǧaba allā takūna
lahū nihāyatun, wa-laysa yaṯbutu hāḏā l-maʿnā bi-ḍṭirārin li-annahū wa-in
kānat awwaliyyatun li-kulli kāʾinin fa-laysa yalzamu bi-ḍṭirārin mā kānat lahū
awwaliyyatun an yakūna ḥādiṯan 823.2–4 / fol. 336a (naql qadīm); 6, 168b2 =
834.7 / fol. 338a (naql qadīm).
1.2 renders ἀρχή(principle), normally translated as awwalun, in the compara-
tive degree as expressed in the phrase μᾶλλον ἀρχή(more of a principle) : πότερον
ζῷον ἢἄνθρωπος ἀρχήτε καὶμᾶλλον ἔστι παρὰτὸκαθ᾽ἕκαστον Arist. Metaph. Β
1, 995b31 = hali l-ḥayawānu ami l-insānu awǧabu awwaliyyatan min ašḫāṣihā l-
mufradāti 173.9; εἰμὲν γὰρ δεῖ(δεῖAb, Arab. appar. : ὅτι Π Ascl. : ἀεὶAlp, ed.) τὰ
καθόλου μᾶλλον ἀρχαί, φανερὸν … Β 3, 998b17* = li-annahū in kānat lā maḥālata
l-ašyāʾu l-kulliyyatu awǧaba awwaliyyatan min ġayrihā fa-maʿlūmun … 219.13;
πρὸς δὲτούτοις ἔτι μᾶλλον αἱδιαφοραὶἀρχαὶἢτὰγένη 998b31 = wa-maʿa hāḏā hali
l-fuṣūlu awǧabu awwaliyyatan ami l-aǧnāsu 227.6.
1.3 sem.; etym.; ἀρχαιόπλουτος (having old money, inherited wealth) = ḏū l-
awwaliyyatiwa-l-qidmatifīl-ġinā:καὶγὰρἐνταῦθαμᾶλλονλυποῦσινοἱνεόπλουτοι
ἄρχοντεςδιὰτὸνπλοῦτονἢοἱἀρχαιόπλουτοι Arist.Rhet.II9,1387a23=fa-innahāḏā
ayḍanmimmāyaġīẓubi-ziyādatinaʿnīannahumʿalāllaḏīnayastaġnūnaminal-
sulṭāni ḥadīṯan ašaddu ġayẓan bi-sababi l-ġinā minhum ʿalā ḏawī l-awwaliyyati
wa-l-qidmati fī l-ġinā 114.14.
2. sem. amplif.; added as a cognate acc. of specification to awwalu
2.1 sem. amplif.; added as a cognate acc. after πρῶτος ( first) = awwalu : πρῶ-
τον ἂν εἴη τῇφύσει τὸπῦρ Arist. Cael. III 5, 303b20 = kānati l-nāru awwala l-ašyāʾi
kullihā awwaliyyatan ṭabīʿiyyatan version B 333.5.
2.2 sem. amplif.; added as a cognate acc. after πρότερος (prior) = in hend.
qabla … wa-awwalun lahū : τὸγὰρ τέλειον πρότερον τῇφύσει τοῦἀτελοῦς Arist.
Cael.I2,269a19=li-annal-tāmmawa-l-kāmilaqablal-nāqiṣiwa-huwaawwalun
lahū awwaliyyatan ṭabīʿiyyatan version B (om. ed. Badawī). |
2.3 sem. amplif.; added as a cognate acc. after ἀρχοειδής (having the nature
of a principle) = awwalun : εἰμᾶλλόν γε ἀρχοειδὲς τὸἕν ἐστιν Arist. Metaph.
Β 3, 999a1–2 = in kāna l-wāḥidu awwalan awǧaba awwaliyyatan min ġayrihī
227.9.
3. sem. amplif.; added in a prepositional phrase of specification modifying
awwalu and wāḥidun
3.1 sem. amplif.; added in a prepositional phrase of specification after a com-
parative modifying ἀρχή( first principle) = awwalun : εἰδέτινων μὴδεῖζητεῖν
ἀπόδειξιν, τίνα ἀξιοῦσιν εἶναι μᾶλλον τοιαύτην ἀρχὴν οὐκ ἂν ἔχοιεν εἰπεῖν Arist.
Metaph. Γ 4, 1006a11 = wa-ammā in kāna mina l-ašyāʾi mā lā yanbaġī lanā an
naṭluba burhānahū wa-lā (sic cod., ed. for fa-lā) yaqdiru aḥadun an yaqūla inna
awwalan āḫara miṯla hāḏā l-awwali illā annahū aqdamu minhu fī l-awwaliyyati
347.12ⓧ.
3.2 sem. amplif.; added in a prepositional phrase of specification which transl.
πρῶτος ( first) and modifies ἕν (one) = mutaqaddimun bi-l-awwaliyyati : πάντα
πρὸς τὸπρῶτον ἀναφέρεται, οἷον ὅσα ἓν λέγεται πρὸς τὸπρῶτον ἕν Arist. Metaph.
Γ 2, 1004a26 = nusiba ǧamīʿu l-ašyāʾi ilā l-awwali llaḏī huwa awwalun lahā ka-
qawlinā inna ǧamīʿa l-ašyāʾi llatī yuqālu fīhā (xqālu fīhā cod. : tuqālu in Averroes
comm. p. 322.8, Latin and Hebrew transl., ed.) wāḥidun tunsabu ilā l-wāḥidi l-
mutaqaddimi bi-l-awwaliyyati 317.15*.
